sa: मया क्रीड महाराज सीतया किं तवानया॥ विवर्णया कृपणया मानुष्या राक्षसेश्वर।
en: Do you sport with me. O great king. What shall you do with her? O lord of Rākşasas-a human being poorly and of a pale countenance.

sa: अमृतं विषसंपृक्तं त्वया वानर भाषितम्। यच्च नान्यमना रामो यच्च शोकपरायणः॥
en: O monkey, what you had said that Rāma is not attached to any other thing and is worn with grief, is like nectar mixed with poison.

sa: नापहर्तुमहं शक्या तस्य रामस्य धीमतः। विधिस्तव वधार्थाय विहितो नात्र संशयः॥
en: You could not have ravished me in the presence of the highly intelligent Rāma. And undoubtedly for your destruction this has been brought about by God.

sa: जहि वीर महावीयौं भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। अदृश्योदृश्यमानो वा सर्वथा त्वं बलाधिकः॥
en: O hero, gifted with great prowess as you are, do you, hidden (in clouds) or appearing before them, slay the two heroic brothers Rāma and Laksmana.

sa: स तां बुद्ध्वार्थतत्त्वेन सिंहिकां मतिमान् कपिः। व्यवर्धत महाकायः प्रावृषीव बलाहकः॥
en: And concluding her to be Sinhikā from her act, the intelligent monkey attaining a gigantic body, increased himself, like a mass of clouds during the rains.

sa: हीनवीर्यमिवाशक्तं पौरुषेण विवर्जितम्। भीरं लघुमिवासत्त्वं विहीनमिव तेजसा॥ विमुक्तमिव मायाबिरलैरिव बहिष्कृतम्। मामवज्ञाय दुर्बुद्धे स्वया बुद्ध्या विचेष्टसे॥
en: perverse sense, disregarding me as devoid of prowess, and incompetent, and bereft of vigour-as cowardly, light, nerveless and shorn of energy, and as divorced by the power of illusion and debarred by arms, you act on your own understanding.

sa: अचिरान्मोक्ष्यते सीते देवि ते जघनं गताम्। धृतामेकां बहून्मासान्वेणी रामो महाबलः॥
en: O Sitä, soon shall the highly powerful Răma loosen this braid of your reaching to your hips, which you have been wearing for many a month.

sa: साहमेवंविधे काले मर्तुमिच्छामि सर्वतः। न च मे विहितो मृत्युरस्मिन् दुःखेऽतिवर्तति॥
en: At this time of distress, I do with all my heart long for death, (but alas!) even death is not approaching me is this my misery.

sa: शशास कपिसेनां तां बलादादाय वीर्यवान्। अङ्गदः सह नीलेन तिष्ठेदुरसि दुर्जयः॥
en: He ordered that monkey-army, saying, taking his own forces, let the puissant and invincible Angada along with Nila, station himself in the centre of the forces.

sa: तस्य दृष्ट्वा मुखं देवि पूर्णचन्द्रमिवोदितम्। मोक्ष्यसे शोकजं वारि निर्मोकमिव पन्नगी॥
en: O exalted one, seeing his face like the full moon risen, you shall shed water begot of ruth, even as a she-serpent casts off her slough.

sa: आस्यैश्च नेत्रैः श्रवणैः पपात रुधिरं बहु। विघूर्णमानो निश्चेष्टो रथोपस्य उपाविशत्॥
en: And blood gushed out in streams from his mouths and eyes and arms, and staggered and senseless, he sat down on the platform of his car.

sa: हनूमन् सिंहसंकाशौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। सुग्रीवं च सहामात्यं सर्वान् ब्रूया अनामयम्॥
en: O Hanumān, communicate tidings of my good health to those lion-like brothers, Rāma and Laksmana, to' Sugriva along with his counsellors, and to all (the monkeys).

sa: न साम रक्षःसु गुणाय कल्पते न दानमर्थोपचितेषु युज्यते। न भेदसाध्या बलदर्पिता जनाः पराक्रमस्त्वेष ममेह रोचते॥
en: No treaty with Rākşasa can answer the end. Neither can gifts prevail with the wealthy. Nor is it possible to sow dissensions among persons proud of their strength. Then, display of prowess appear to me applicable in this case.

sa: लोहितार्दास्तु बहवः शेरते वानरर्षभाः। निरस्ताः पतिता भूमौ ताम्रपुष्पा इव दुमाः॥
en: Many a prime monkey, crimsoned and drenched (with blood) lay down (on the ground); and many, resisted dropped to the earth, like trees bearing coppery flowers.

sa: न शक्यः स सुरैर्द्रष्टुं नासुरैर्न च पन्नगैः। यस्य प्रसादं कुरुते स वै तं द्रष्टुमर्हति॥ नहि यज्ञफलैस्तात न तपोभिस्तु संचितैः। शक्यते भगवान्द्रष्टु न दानेन न चेज्यया॥ तद्भक्तैस्तद्गतप्राणैस्तचित्तैस्तत्परायणैः। शक्यते भगवान्द्रष्टुं ज्ञाननिर्दग्धकिल्बिषैः॥ अथवा पृच्छ्य रक्षेन्द्र यदि तं द्रष्टुमिच्छसि। कथयिष्यामि ते सर्वं श्रूयतां यदि रोचते॥ कृते युगे व्यतीते वै मुखे त्रेतायुगस्य तु। हितार्थं देवमानां भविता नृपविग्रहः॥ इक्ष्वाकूणां च यो राजा भाव्यो दशरथो भुवि। तस्य सुनुर्महातेजा रामो नाम भविष्यत
en: The celestials, Asuras or Nagas-none is capable of casting his looks upon him. He alone can see him with whom he is pleased, O my son; neither by the fruits of sacrifices, asceticism, selfcontrol, gifts, sacrifices, nor by anything else can one behold the Illustrious Deity. Those alone can see Him, who have devoted themselves, their life and being, to him and who, by virtue of discriminative knowledge, have got their sins burnt. if you are willing to behold him hear, if you do like, I shall describe everything at length. At the end of the golden age and the beginning of Tretā Yuga the deity Nārāyaṇa shall assume a human form for the benefit of men and celestials. A son by the name of Rāma shall be born to Dasaratha, of the Ikşvaku race who shall govern earth. Rāma shall be highly effulgent

sa: तामापतन्तीं भरतानुजोस्त्रैर्जधान बाणैश्च हुताग्निकल्पैः। तथापि सा तस्य विवेश शक्तिर्भुजान्तरं दाशरथेविशालम्॥
en: As it coursed on, Bharata's younger brother resisted it with arrows resembling a sacrificial flame. Yet the dart pierced into the broad arm of Dasaratha's son.

sa: तयोत्सृष्टः स तु शिशुः शरदर्कसमद्युतिः। निधायास्ये स्वयं मुष्टिं रुरोद शनकैस्तदा॥
en: And forsaken by them both, the infant furnished with the brightness of the autumnal sun, entering his clenched fist into his mouth, began to cry slowly.

sa: हंसानां हि पुरा राम न वर्णः सर्वपाण्डुरः। पक्षा नीलाग्रसंवीताः क्रोडाः शष्पाग्रनिर्मलाः॥ अथाब्रवीद्वैश्रवणः कृकलासं गिरौ स्थितम्।
en: Formerly, O Rama, swans had not a hue of one unvaried whiteness. Their wings ended in, blue, and their breasts wore the spotless hue of tender grass. Then Vaiśravana addressed the chameleon as it was stationed at the mountain.

sa: शक्या लोभयितुं नाहमैश्वर्येण धनेन वा। अनन्या राघवेणाहं भास्करेण यथा प्रभा॥
en: With wealth or riches you shall not be able to tempt me. As the rays of the sun belong to him, so I am Rāghava's only.

sa: तौ तु तत्र महारण्ये ववृधाते महौजसौ। कुम्भकर्णदशग्रीवौ लोकोद्वेगकरौ तदा ॥
en: 'Excellent!' And in that extensive forest those exceedingly energetic ones, Kumbhakarņa and the Ten-necked one grew up, and became the sources of anxiety to the people.

sa: प्रकृत्या राक्षसो ह्येष भ्रातामित्रस्य वै प्रभो। आगतश्च रिपुः साक्षात्कथमस्मिंश्च विश्वसेत्॥
en: O lord, this man is a Rākşasa by birth and the brother of our foe and so is he our enemy, how can we trust him?

sa: उभयापि वरो दत्तो राक्षसीनां नृपात्मज॥ सद्योपलब्धिर्गर्भस्य प्रसूतिः सद्य एव च। सद्य एव वय:प्राप्ति मातुरेव वयःसमम्॥
en: O son of the king, Umă also bestowed a boon: “Henceforth the Rāksasis shall conceive in a day, bring forth (child) in a day, and the child shall in a day be furnished with the age of its mother.'

sa: गतासुयोधनिश्चेष्टशरीरशतवाहिनीम्। महाप्रतिभयां रौद्रां घोरां वैतरणीमिव॥
en: Carrying away many, corpses of slain warriors, highly dreadful and fierce and awful

sa: एतत्तु दृश्यते तीर्थ समुद्रस्य वरानने॥ यत्र सागरमुत्तीर्य तां रात्रिमुषिता वयम्।
en: O you having an excellent countenance, do you behold the descending place of the ocean, where I spent the night after crossing the deep for you.

sa: एवमुक्ता मया सा तु सुरसा कामरूपिणी॥ अब्रवीन्नातिवर्तेत कश्चिदेष वरो मम।
en: Thus accosted by me, Surasā, wearing forms at her will, said, 'None is able to escape me. Even this is the boon that I have received.'

sa: शिश्यिरे चाभिभूतानि संत्रस्तान्युद्विजन्ति च॥ संप्रविव्यथिरे चापि न च पस्पन्दिरे भयात्।
en: And overwhelmed with fright, and quaking (for fear), the creatures began to measure their lengths, and they were sore afflicted, and bereft of motion through terror.

sa: यावन लङ्कां समभिद्रवन्ति वलीमुखाः पर्वतकूटमात्राः। दंष्ट्रायुधाश्चैव नखायुधाश्च प्रदीयतां दाशरथाय मैथिली॥
en: Therefore before the monkeys, resembling mountain peaks, having teeth for their arms and nails, for their weapons, subjugate Lankā, do you render Maithili to Dasaratha's son.

sa: तन्न विश्वसनीयं वो राक्षसानां रणाजिरे। एतेनैवोपमानेन नित्यं जिह्मा हि राक्षसाः॥
en: Therefore you must not trust the Raksasas in the field of battle. By this one instance you must know that Rakşasas are ever deceitful in fight.

sa: समायातः समुद्रान्तं हन्तुं मां किल राघवः। वानरेन्द्रप्रणीतेन बलेन महता वृतः॥
en: Surrounded by a vast army gathered by the sovereign of the monkeys, Raghava had presented himself on the shore of the sea, for compassing my destruction.

sa: क्रोधात्सूतं च दुर्धर्षः स्यन्दनस्थमुवाच ह। परसैन्यस्य मध्येन यावदन्तो नयस्व माम्॥
en: And in anger, that irrepressible one said to the charioteer, stationed on the car, “Do you take me to the other end of the enemies' host."

sa: कल्याणी वत गाथेयं लौकिकी प्रतिभाति मा। एति जीवन्तमानन्दो नरं वर्षशतादपि॥
en: Verily the wise saw of the people appears to me to be true that once in a hundred years true joy appears to a living man.

sa: मातले पश्य संरब्धमापतन्तं रथं रिपोः॥ यथापसव्यं पतता वेगेन महता पुनः। समरे हन्तुमात्मानं तथानेन कृता मतिः॥
en: O Mătalī, behold the enraged chariot of my foe as it course on. From the furious speed with which he is again wheeling at my right, it appear that he has set his heart of slaying me in encouter.

sa: अर्थस्यैते परित्यागे दोषाः प्रव्याहृता मया। राज्यमुत्सृजता धीर येन बुद्धिस्त्वया कृता॥
en: All these that I have en-numerated are the evils of forsaking fortune. (I cannot divine) what made you, renouncing the monarchy, to adopt such a course.

sa: यां कपीनां सहस्राणि सुबहून्ययुतानि च। दिक्षु सर्वासु मार्गन्ते सेयमासादिता मया॥
en: At length my watchful eyes have seen her, whom have been seeking in vain, the thousands and millions of the monkeys in all directions and quarters.

sa: मां हि धर्मात्मनः पत्नीं शचीमिव शचीपतेः। त्वदन्यस्त्रिषु लोकेषु प्रार्थयेन्मनसाऽपि कः॥
en: Who is there in the three worlds, who even desire me in mind, who am the spouse of the virtuous souled (Rāma) like to Indra's Sacī.

sa: ब्रुवतश्चाङ्गदस्यैवं श्रुत्वा वचनमुत्तमम्। प्रहृष्टमनसो वाक्यमिदमूचुर्वनौकसः॥
en: Hearing those sweet words of the prince Angada, the monkeys delightedly replied, saying.

sa: अतिमानश्च बालश्च दुर्विनीतश्च राक्षस। बद्धस्त्वं कालपाशेन ब्रूहि मां यद्यदिच्छसि ॥
en: You are proud, and haughty, and a boy, O Raksasa. You are fettered by the noose of Fate. Do you say to me whatever you like.

sa: ततोऽभ्यवकिरन्त्वन्ये लाजैः पुष्पैश्च सर्वतः। समुच्छ्रितपताकास्तु रथ्याः पुरवरोत्तमे॥ शोभयन्तु च वेश्मानि सूर्यस्योदयनं प्रति। स्रग्दाममुक्तपुष्पैश्च सुवर्णैः पञ्चवर्णकैः॥
en: Thereafter sprinkle all the places with flowers and dried paddy; hoist up flags all over the city; decorate all the houses, before the rising of the moon with garlands, jewels, flowers of gold and things of five other colours.

sa: यदाश्रयादवष्टव्धा नेयं मामुपतिष्ठते। सोऽस्या भर्ता सह भ्रात्रा निहतो रणमूर्धनि ॥
en: That one depending on whom she had proudly set her face against me, that husband of hers, along with his brother, has been slain in conflict.

sa: विमानस्थास्तदा देवा गन्धर्वाश्च महोरगाः। ऋषिदानवदैत्याश्च गरुत्मन्तश्च खेचराः॥ ददृशुस्ते तदा युद्धं लोकसंवर्तसंस्थितम्। नानाप्रहरणै मैः शूरयोः संप्रयुध्यतोः॥
en: Then stationed in the sky celestials and Gandharvas and mighty serpents and saints and Dānavas and Daityas and those related to Garuda-fowls-beheld that conflict like to the universal tumbling as the two heroes faught on with various dire arms.

sa: तदैव यन्न दग्धस्त्वं धर्षयंस्तनुमध्यमाम्। देवा बिभ्यति ते सर्वे सेन्द्राः साग्निपुरोगमाः।।२४
en: You were not burnt down when you did captivate that middle-statured (damsel) whom fear all the celestial headed by Indra and Agni. (The god of Fire).

sa: कुर्याम तद् वयं कर्म क्रियासु सुहृदश्च नः। कृतवान् यादृगौकस्तव पुत्रोमहारथः॥
en: We, supported by our allies, desire to accomplish that feat in this battle, the like of which, O lady, your son, that mighty carwarrior, achieved single-handed.

sa: अभिदुद्राव वेगेन द्रोणस्य वधकाझया। आमिषार्थी यथा सिंहो वने मत्तमिव द्विपम्॥
en: He, then with great impetuosity, rushed towards Drona with the intention of killing hiin, as a hungry lion runs towards a mad elephant in the forest.

sa: न हि भीष्मं महेष्वासं पाण्डवाः पाण्डुपूर्वज। अशक्नुवन् रणे जेतुं पाशहस्तमिवान्तकम्॥
en: Then the Pandavas could not vanquish in battle that fierce bowman that sire of Pandu, who then resembled the Destroyer himself with his noose in hand.

sa: एवं ब्रुवति विप्रेन्द्र धृतराष्ट्रोऽम्बिकासुतः। आक्षिप्य वाक्यं वाक्यज्ञो वाक्यं चैवाब्रवीत् पुनः॥
en: When that foremost of Brahmanas (Vyasa) was thus speaking in a sorrowful tone, the son of Ambika, accomplished in speech, king Dhritarashtra, thus spoke to him.

sa: मम भीमः सखा चैव सम्बन्धी च महाबलः। भक्तोऽस्मान् भक्तिमांश्चाहं तमप्यरिनिषूदनम्॥
en: Moreover that highly powerful Bhima is my friend and relative. He is devoted to me, and I cherish a great devotion for that slayer of foes.

sa: भीष्मोऽपि रथिनां श्रेष्ठः प्रतिजग्राह तां चमूम्। आपतन्ती महाराज वेलामिव महोदधिः॥
en: Like the banks receiving the surging waves of the mighty main, Bhishma also, O monarch, that foremost of car-warrior, received that assailing host of the enemy.

sa: ऋते कृष्णान्महाभागात् पाण्डवाद् वा धनञ्जयात्। एष तस्मात् पुरोधाय कञ्चिदन्यं ममाग्रतः॥
en: Except the illustrious Krishna or Dhananjaya the son of Pandu, I do not find any one in the three worlds who can slay me in battle.

sa: स च्छिन्नधन्वा समरे गदां गुर्वी महायशाः। द्रोणाय प्रेषयामास गिरिसारमयीं बली॥
en: When his bow was thus cut off in that battle, that highly and illustrious warriors hurled on Drona a mace with the firmness of a mountain.

sa: आपतन्तं च तं दृष्ट्वा गजानीकं वृकोदरः। गदापाणिरवारोहद् रथात् सिहं इवोन्नदन्॥
en: Thereat Vrikodara, beholding that division of elephants make towards himself,, descended from his car, holding a mace in his hands and roaring out like a lion.

sa: अर्जुनं समरे योद्धं नोत्सहेतापि वासवः॥ किमु भीष्मो रणे वीरा गतसत्त्वोऽल्पजीवितः।
en: Even Vasava himself is not capable of withstanding Arjuna in battle, what to speak of the heroic Bhishma whose energy is gone and life is exhausted?”

sa: अब्रवीद् भरतश्रेष्ठ मद्रराजमिदं वचः। एष पाण्डुसुतो ज्येष्ठो यमाभ्यां सहितो रणे॥
en: Said, O foremost of the Bharatas, these words to the king of the Madras: “This eldest son of Pandu, supported by his twin brothers in battle.

sa: संजय उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य केशवस्य महात्मनः। सुभद्रा पुत्रशोकार्ता विललाप सुदुःखिता॥
en: Sanjaya said Having heard these words of Keshava of high-soul, Subhadra afflicted with grief on account of her son and sorely distressed, began to lament piteously.

sa: अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च। निर्ममो निरहंकारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी॥ संतुष्टः सतत योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः। मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः॥
en: He is dear to Me who has no hatred for anything, who is friendly and compassionate, who is free from egoism, who has no vanity, who is alike in pleasure and pain, who is forgiving, contented, always devoted, whose self is subdued, purpose is firm, mind and understanding are fixed on Me.

sa: एकोऽस्त्रवित सखा तेऽयं सोऽप्यस्मान् समुपेक्षते। निर्दह्यमानान् भीष्मेण द्रोणेन च महात्मना॥
en: This your friend (Arjuna) alone is learned in all weapons. Seeing us consumed by Bhishma and the illustrious Drona, he only looks on us with indifference.

sa: संजय उवाच दृष्ट्वा भीष्मेण संसक्तान् भ्रातृनन्यांश्च पार्थिवान्। समभ्यधावद् गाङ्गेयमुद्यतास्त्रो धनंजयः॥
en: Sanjaya said Seeing his brother (Bhima) and other kings (of the Pandava host) engaged with Bhishma with weapons uplifted, Dhananjaya rushed against the son of Ganga.

sa: तस्य कायं विनिर्भिद्य न्यमज्जद् धरणीतले। ततः पपात द्विरदो वजाहत इवाचलः॥
en: That Naracha, penetrating through the body of the elephant at last struck on the ground. Then that elcphant fell like a mountain struck with the thunder-bolt.

sa: अभ्युद्ययुस्ते शितशस्त्रहस्ता रिरक्षिषन्तो रथमर्जुनस्य। पार्थोऽपि तानापतत: समीक्ष्य त्रिगर्तराज्ञा सहितान् नृवीरान्॥
en: Grasping in their hand well-sharpened weapons, rushed in battle desirous of protecting the car of Arjuna. Beholding those king make towards himself, the son of Pritha,

sa: सोऽभिगम्याब्रवीद् वाक्यं प्राप्तोऽस्मि भगवन्निति। तमब्रवीत् ततः स्थूण: प्रीतोऽस्मीति पुनः पुनः॥
en: Approaching him, he said these words” I am come to you) O god. “Thereupon Sthuna said to him again and again, I am pleased (with you).”

sa: त्रिदशाऽपि समुधुक्ता नालं भीष्मं समासितुम्। किमु पार्था महात्मानं मर्त्यभूता महाबलाः॥
en: Even the celestial striving vigorously cannot overcome the mighty and high-souled Bhishma in battle, what to speak of the sons of Pritha who are mere mortals.

sa: तस्मिन्निपतिते वीरे त्रस्तास्तस्य पदानुगा:। व्यद्रवन्त भयाद् भीता यत्र दौर्योधनं बलम्॥
en: At the fall of that brave warrior, his followers, were inspired with terror; and seized with panic they ran to where the army of Duryodhana was.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच किमर्थं भरतश्रेष्ठ नैव हन्याः शिखण्डिनम्। उद्यतेषुमथो दृष्ट्वा समरेष्वाततायिनम्॥
en: Duryodhana said For what reason, ( chief among the Bharatas, will you not slay Shikhandin even though you see him ready to strike you in battle.

sa: वियतां च वरः पार्थ किमस्मत्तोऽभिकाडक्षसि। एवंगते महाराज न तवास्ति पराजयः॥
en: O son of Pritha, ask for a boon which you desire to get. O great king, if it so happens, then defeat will not be yours.

sa: ततः सूतो ममात्यर्थं कश्मलं प्राविशन्महत्। पृथिव्यां च शराघातानिपपात मुमोह च॥
en: Then did my charioteer fall into a deep trance and by reason of his being struck with arrows fell down in the earth and became senseless.

sa: अयुद्धेन निवृत्तिं च मनसा चिन्तय प्रभो। देवतानां प्रसादेन सर्वमेतद् भविष्यति॥
en: O my lord, think in your mind (about a way) for pacification without involving a war. Through the grace of the gods, all this will happen.

sa: सर्वपारशवीं चैव शक्तिं शूरः सुदक्षिणः। सघण्टां प्राहिणोद् घोरां क्रुद्धो गाण्डीवधन्वने॥
en: Thereafter the brave Sudakshina inflamed with rage hurled at the wielder of the Gandiva bow, a lance, dreadful, tied with bells and made wholly of iron.

sa: गतोदके सेतुबन्धो यादृक् तादृड्मतिस्तव। संदीप्ते भवने यद्वत् कूपस्य खननं तथा॥
en: Your understanding is like building an embankment when the waters have escaped. It is like the digging of a well when the house is on fire.

sa: भीमसेनश्च बलवान् माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ। वासुदेवश्च वार्ष्णेयो यस्य नाथो व्यवस्थितः॥
en: The mighty Bhimasena and the two sons of Pandu begotten upon Madri, and who have the son of Vasudeva of the Vrishni race for his Saviour.

sa: संजय उवाच अथात्मजं तव पुनर्गाङ्गेयो ध्यानमास्थितम्। अब्रवीद् भरतश्रेष्ठः सम्प्रहर्षकरं वचः॥
en: Sanjaya said Then, O foremost of the Bharatas, the son of Ganga, seeing your son plunged in thought, once more addressed these delightful words to him.

sa: गत्वा मम वचो ब्रूहि वासुदेवस्य शृण्वतः। इदं तत् समनुप्राप्तं वर्षपूगाभिचिन्तितम्॥
en: And going there say this on my behalf within the hearing of Vasudeva; "What has been expected for a long series of years has now come.

sa: कुञ्जरेण प्रभिन्नेन सप्तधा स्रवता मदम्। पर्वतेन यथा तोयं स्रवमाणेन सर्वशः॥
en: On his elephant with rent temples and with the temporal juice trickling down in seven distinct lines like so many billets flowing down the mountain barest.

sa: संजय उवाच हिरण्वत्यां निविष्टेषु पाण्डवेषु महात्मसु। न्यविशन्त महाराज कौरवेया यथाविधि।।।।
en: Sanjaya said The great souled sons of Pandu having fixed their encampment at Hiranvati, the sons of Kuru too encamped there as usual, O great king.

sa: न विद्ध्वा भारतं षष्ट्या निशितैर्लोमवाहिभिः। नृत्यन्निव रथोपस्थे विधुन्वानो महद् धनुः॥
en: Seemed to dance on the terrace of his car, wielding his massive bow. Thereupon the grandsire hurled at him a mighty lance made entirely of iron,

sa: विरथांस्तव पुत्रांस्तु कृत्वा राजन् महाहवे। न जगान नरव्याघ्रः स्मरन् भीमवचस्तदा॥
en: Depriving, O monarch, your sons of their chariot, in that great battle, that foremost of men, Abhimanyu did not slay them recollecting the words of Bhima.

sa: तस्माद् विधाय नगरे विधानं सचिवैः सह। अर्चयस्व यथाकामं दैवतानि विशाम्पते॥
en: Therefore, having taken the necessary steps as regard this city with your ministers, pay adoration, O lord of earth, to the gods according to your desire.

sa: व्यनदत् सुमहानादं जीमूत इव शारदः। दिशः खं विदिशश्चैव नादयन् भैरवस्वनः॥
en: Then he uttered a loud roar that resembled the rumble of autumnal clouds; and that dreadful reverberated through the subsidiary and cardinal points of the compass.

sa: भीमसेनं तथा दृष्ट्वा प्राक्रोशंस्तावका नृप। कालोऽयं भीमरूपेण कलिङ्गैः सह युध्यते॥
en: O king, seeing Bhima in this fearful fight, all the troops exclaimed, “This one who is fighting in Bhima's shape with the Kalingas is Yama himself".

sa: मार्गः सकौशिकाद्यैश्च लाघवेन बलेन च॥ आर्जुनिर्व्यचरद् व्योम्नि भृशं वै पक्षिराडिव।
en: Exhibiting great prowess and great lightness, Arjuna's son roved in the air like the king of the birds, in various motions, known as Kaushika and others.

sa: यमाहुः सर्वपितरं वासुदेवं द्विजातयः। अपि वा ह्येष पाण्डूनां योत्स्यतेऽर्थाय संजय॥
en: That son of Vasudeva, whom all the regenerate ones call the Father of all, O Sanjaya, will battle for the interests of the sons of Pandu?

sa: यज्ञशिष्टाशिनः सन्तो मुच्यन्ते सर्वकिल्बिषैः। भुञ्जते ते त्वघं पापा ये पचन्त्यात्मकारणात्॥
en: The good men, who eat the leavings of the Sacrifice, are freed from all sins, but the bad men, who cook food for themselves, incur sin.

sa: ततोऽर्जुनं वासुदेवः प्रत्युवाचार्थवद् वचः। शृणु गुह्यमिदं पार्थ पुरा वृत्तं यथानघ॥
en: Thereupon the son of Vasudeva addressing Arjuna spoke these words in reply-"Hear, O sinless one, O son of Pritha, this ancient and mysterious piece of history.

sa: दिवसे दिवसे ह्यस्या गतिजल्पितचेष्टितम्। प्रत्याहरंश्च मे युक्ताः स्थिताः प्रियहिते सदा॥
en: Day after day, they went and learnt whatever she did, being devoted and always stationed at their duty, and brought them to me, always their well-wisher.

sa: तस्या निर्ध्वजं छित्त्वा हत्वोभी पार्ष्णिसारथी॥ तं विव्याधायसैः षड्भिः सोपाक्रामद् स्थान्तरम्।
en: The son of Arjuna then cutting off his bow and slaying his two flank-supporters, pierced him with six iron-made shafts; and then Shalya ascended another chariot.

sa: अश्ववृन्दैर्महद्भिश्च ऋष्टितोमरधारिभिः। नागे नागे रथाः सप्त सप्त चाश्वा रथे रथे॥
en: And with large division of cavalry armed with scimitars and lances. Near every elephants were stationed seven car-warriors, and near every car were placed seven horsemen,

sa: संधाय च शरं दीप्तमभिमत्र्य स पाण्डवः। पर्जन्यास्त्रेण संजोज्य सर्वलोकस्य पश्यतः॥
en: And fixing on his bowstring an effulgent arrow inspired with aphorisms and identified with the Parjanya weapon, before the very eyes of all the people present,

sa: पित्रा तुष्टेन मे पूर्व यदा कालीमुदावहम्॥ स्वच्छन्दमरणं दत्तमवध्यत्वं रणे तथा।
en: Formerly on the occasion of his marrying Kali, my father gratified with me, accorded me two boons, viz., death at my pleasure, and unslayableness in battle.

sa: कथं च वो रथस्थानां शरवर्षाणि मुञ्चताम्। नीतोऽभिमन्युनिधनं कदर्थीकृत्य वः परैः॥
en: You were all then on your chariots and were shooting your arrows; how could then Abhimanyu be slain by the enemy spreading havoc in your troops?

sa: तस्य चिच्छेद तां शक्तिं पञ्चधा पञ्चभिः शरैः॥ संक्रुद्धो भरतश्रेष्ठ भीष्मबाहुप्रवेरिताम्।
en: Then, O foremost of the Bharatas, inflamed with rage, Arjuna with those five arrows, splintered into five fragments that lance hurled with strength of Bhishma's arms.

sa: एष ते विस्तरस्तात संक्षेपश्च प्रकीर्तितः। केशवस्य यथातत्त्वं सुप्रीतो भज केशवम्॥
en: Thus, O Sire, has been described to you, in detail and in brief, the real nature of Keshava. Now turn you heart in love to Keshava.

sa: भारद्वाजोऽब्रवीद् वाक्यं तावकानां महारथान्। क्षिप्रं गच्छत भद्रं वो राजानं परिरक्षत॥
en: The son of Bharadvaja spoke these words to the mighty car-warriors of your army "Good betide you all die yourselves and strive to rescue the king.

sa: दुर्गं तरति चावश्यं तथा चौरैर्विमुच्यते। संग्रामे विजयेन्नित्यं लक्ष्मी प्राप्नोति केवलाम्॥
en: He is certain to get over all difficulties, be is certain to be freed from thieves. He will ever win victory, and the goddess of prosperity.

sa: ताभ्याः मुक्ताः शरा राजन्नन्तरिक्षे विरेजिरे। हंसा इव महाराज शरत्काले नभस्तले॥
en: Those arrows, O king discharged by Drona and Susharma, shone, O mighty monarch, in the heavens like a row of crane in the firmament in Autumn.

sa: ममैष आचार्यसुतो द्रोणस्यापि प्रियः सुतः। ब्राह्मणश्च विशेषेण माननीयो ममेति च॥
en: This is the son of my preceptor; this is the very dear son of Drona; especially he is a Brahmana, and so worthy of my veneration.

sa: दुर्वासा नाम विप्रर्षिस्तथा परमकोपनः। आराधितः सदारेण स चास्मै प्रददौ वरान्॥
en: That highly passionate Brahmanical sage, by name Durvasa, was adored by him (Krishna) along with his wives. The sage (pleased with him) accorded boons to him.

sa: सेनापतिं समाकर्ण्य श्वेतं युधि निपातितम्। तदर्थं यततां चापि परेषां प्रपलायिनाम्॥
en: When they heard that their general Shveta had been killed, what took place between those that fought to kill him and those that retreated before them.

sa: एवं वरमह श्रुत्वा जगत्यास्तनये तदा। अमोघमस्त्रं प्रायच्छं वैष्णवं परमं पुरां॥
en: Listening then to that prayer for the boon that earth wanted me accord to her son, I gave the excellent and irresistible Vaishnava weapon to him.

sa: यथोदयन् वै गगने सूर्यो हन्ति महत् ममः। तथार्जुनो गजानीकमवधीत् कङ्कपत्रिभिः॥
en: Just as the sun rising in the heavens destroys deep darkness (of night), so did Arjuna destroy elephant with his arrows furnished with wings of Kanka-feathers.

sa: कार्तिकेयो यथा नित्यं देवानामभवत् पुरा॥ तथा त्वमपि पाण्डूना सेनानी: पुरुषर्षभ।
en: O foremost of men, as in the days of yore, Kartikeya was the commander of the celestial army, so are you commander of the Pandava army.

sa: शल्यश्च समरे जिष्णु कृपश्च रथिनां वरः। विव्यधाते महाराज बहुधा मर्मभेदिभिः॥
en: Shalya and Kripa those foremost of carwarriors also pierced in battle, Jishnu with myriads of shafts. O king, each capable to penetrating into the very vitals.

sa: तत्रेष्ट्वा तु गतः सिद्धिं सहस्राक्षो महायशाः। स्रष्टा भूतपतिर्यत्र सर्वलोकैः सनातनः॥
en: It was there that of greatly renowned Indra obtained success by performing sacrifices. There the lord of all creatures, the eternal creator of all the worlds.

sa: इमां च पृथिवीं सर्वां मणिरत्नविभूषिताम्। सौवर्णीमकरोद् राजा ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च तां ददौ॥
en: The entire Earth adorned with jewels and gems, the king caused to be covered over with gold and he then gave her away to the Brahmanas.

sa: तामेवं भाषमाणां तु शाल्व: काशिपते: सुताम्। अत्यजद् भरतश्रेष्ठ जीर्णां त्वचमिवोरगः॥
en: Shalva however abandoned that daughter of the ruler of the Kashis who spoke thus, O chief among the Bharatas, like a serpent casting off its slough.

sa: गौतमोऽपि त्वरायुक्तो माधवं नवभिः शरैः। हृदि विव्याध संक्रुद्धः कङ्कपत्रपरिच्छदैः। :॥
en: The son of Gautami also great celerity and waxing worth, pierced the descendant of Madhu's race on the breast with nine shafts decked with golden wings.

sa: अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणां देवर्षीणां च नारदः। गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः॥
en: And the fig tree among all trees; I am Narada among celestial Rishis, and Chitraratha among Gandharvas. I un Kapila among all ascetics successful in Yoga.

sa: अमोघं दर्शनं मह्यं कामप्राप्तिरतोऽस्तु वः। एवमुक्तास्तु ते सर्वे प्रत्यूचुस्तं दिवौकसः॥
en: A sight of my self cannot be barren. So let the fruition of your desires proceed from this!” Thus spoken to, all those denizens of heaven

sa: परेषां क्रौञ्च एवासीद् व्यूहो राजन् महात्मनाम्। प्रीयमाणेन विहितो धर्मराजेन भारत॥
en: The army of our high-souled enemies was formed in the shape of a Krauncha (crane). O Bharata, by the very virtuous Yudhishthira with a delighted heart.

sa: द्रवतश्च महीपालान् पश्य यौधिष्ठिरे बले। दृष्ट्वा हि भीष्मं समरे व्यात्ताननमिवान्तकम्॥
en: Behold, all the kings of Yudhisthira's army are flying away, on seeing Bhishma in battle who looks like the destroyer himself with his wide open mouth.

sa: न धृत्या न पुनस्त्यागान्मृत्योः कश्चिद् विमुच्यते। कालो नूनं महावीर्यः सर्वलोकदुरत्ययः॥
en: Nor by firmness, nor by gift, can a man free himself from death. The greatly powerful Time cannot be transgressed by any thing in the world.

sa: भीमसेनोऽपि राजेन्द्र दुर्योधनमुखान् रथान्। अवजित्य ततः संख्ये ययौ स्वशिबिरं प्रति॥
en: Bhimasena also, o foremost of kings having vanquished in battle the kings, all good car-warriors, headed by Duryodhana hiinself, retired to his own camp. slain many

sa: ध्वजं केसरिणं चास्य चिच्छेद विशिखैस्त्रिभिः। निर्बिभेद त्रिभिश्चान्यैः सारथिं चास्य पत्रिभिः॥
en: Then with three shafts he cut down Bhima's standard bearing the device of the lion, and with another three winged shafts be penetrated the latter's charioteer.

sa: ततस्तव सुतो राजन् दृष्ट्वा सैन्यं तथागतम्। दुःशासनो भृशं क्रुद्धो युद्धायार्जुनमभ्यगात्॥
en: Then O king your son Dushasana, seeing your troops in that wretched plight became inflamed with rage and advanced towards Arjuna for fighting with the latter.

sa: तमेकं रथिनां श्रेष्ठं शरैस्ते समवाकिरन्। प्रावृषीव यथा मेरुं सिषिचुर्जलदा नृप॥
en: O monarch, they then covered that single handed foremost of car-warriors with an arrow downpour, like rain clouds drenching a mighty cliff in the rainy season.

sa: स हनिष्यति संग्रामे ीष्म परपुरञ्जयम्। अशक्यमपि कुमुद्धि रणे पार्थः समुद्यतः॥
en: Arjuna will slay in battle, Bhishma that conqueror of hostile cities. Putting forth his energies in fight, Partha can achieve what is incapable of being achieved.

sa: अजेयौ समरे वृद्धौ विराटदुपदौ तथा। महारथौ महावीर्यो मतौ मे पुरुषर्षभौ॥
en: The two, Virata and Drupada, invincible and experienced in battle. They are are great car-warriors and these two foremost among men are endued with great energy.

sa: एवं श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य कारुण्याद् बहुविस्तरम्। प्रत्युवाच ततः कृष्णः सान्त्वयानो युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Hearing these many words of Yudhishthra describing the state of affairs in details, out of compassion, Krishna spoke these words in reply to console the former.

sa: ऐरावतेन सा दत्ता अनपत्या महात्मना। पतौ हते सुपर्णेन कृपणा दीनचेतना॥
en: Her husband having been slain by Suparna (Garuda), she was helpless and completely depressed in mind; she was then bestowed upon Arjuna by the illustrious Airavata.

sa: संजय उवाच एवमुक्त्वार्जुनः संख्ये रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्। विसृज्य सशरं चापं शोकसंविग्नमानसः॥
en: Sanjaya said Having thus spoken on the field of battle, Arjuna, with a sorrowful heart, sat down on the car, casting aside his bow and arrows.

sa: विस्तरेणैव मे शंस सर्वे गावल्गणे पुनः। विक्रीडितं कुमारस्य स्कन्दस्येवासुरैः सह॥
en: O son of Gavalgani, relate to me in detail the fight with prince Abhimanyu, that seems to be much like that between Skanda and the Asuras.

sa: तत्रैव वसतस्तस्य रावणो नाम राक्षसः॥ जहार भार्यां वैदेहीं सम्मोद्यैनं सहानुजम्।
en: When he was living there, the Rakshasa, by name Ravana stole away his wife, the princess of Videha, having deceived both himself and his follower Lakshmana.

sa: आयुधानि च सर्वेषां बाहुनपि विभूषितान्। अपतन्तः निकृत्ताङ्गा मृता भूमौ गतासवः॥
en: Their weapons and their hands furnished with these, fell down on earth, and they themselves deprived of life and with their bodies mangled, fell down dead.

sa: दशैव तु सहस्राणि त्रिगर्तानां महारथाः। चत्वारि च सहस्राणि वासुदेवस्य चानुगाः॥
en: Of these fourteen thousand, ten thousand mighty car-warriors belonged to the Trigartta clan and the remaining) four sand were the followers of the son of Vasudeva.

sa: मामद्य सात्वतश्रेष्ठ पातयस्व महाहवे। त्वया हि देव संग्रामे हतस्यापि ममानघ॥
en: Lay me low, O foremost of the Satvata race, this day in this dreadful fight! O sinless one, slain by you in this battle, O god,

sa: स चापि राजा राजेन्द्र पुत्रव्यसनमुत्तमम अप्रसह्यतमं लोके प्राप्तवानिति मे मतिः॥
en: So far as I know, O king, Akampana, while in this world, was also afflicted with the overwhelming and unbearable grief caused by his son's death.

sa: केकयाः पञ्च राजेन्द्रः भ्रातरो दृढविक्रमाः। सर्वे चैव रथोदाराः सर्वे लोहितकध्वजाः॥
en: The five brothers, the Kaikeyas, O chief among kings, are of great prowess. All of them are mighty car-warriors and all of them have blood-red banners.

sa: तस्मिंस्तु निहते सैन्ये तावुभो युद्धदुर्मदौ। संग्रामे समतिष्ठेतां यथा वै वृत्रवासवौ॥
en: When both the divisions of Iravat and Alambusha were slain in battle, those two heroes, both formidable in battle, encountered each other like Indra and Vritra.

sa: समभ्याशगतस्याजौ तस्य खङ्गेन दुर्मतेः। चिच्छेद कार्मुकं दीप्तं शरावापं च सत्वरम्॥
en: And when the former had come very near to him, with his sword he cut off that wicked one's bow and shafts into five fragments each.

sa: ततः सा मन्युनाऽऽविष्टा ज्येष्ठा काशिपतेः सुता। अब्रवीत् साश्रुनयना बाष्यविप्लुतया गिरा।॥
en: Then did that eldest daughter of the ruler of the Kashis struck with grief say with eyes bathed in tears in a voice choked with tears.

sa: ततस्तमिषुजालेन याज्ञसेनिः समावृणोत्। विधूय तद् बाणजालं बभौ तव सुतो बली॥
en: Thereat the son of Yajnasena covered the former with a net-work of arrows. Your son endued with prowess appeared beautiful by defeating that shower of arrows.

sa: सर्वे योधाः सुसंरब्धा बलवन्तो महाबलाः। ते विदेहाः कलिङ्गाश्च दासेरकगणाश्च ह॥
en: All the valiant and highly powerful warriors wrought up with rage, belonging to the clans of the Videhas, the Kalingas, the Daserakas, and many other tribes,

sa: बृहस्पतिरुवाच कृत्वा पापं पूर्वमबुद्धिपूर्व पुण्यानि चेत्कुरुते बुद्धिपूर्वम्। स तत्पापं नुदते कर्मशीलो वासो यथा मलिनं क्षारयुक्तम्॥
en: Brihaspati answered If, having committed sin through foolishness, one performs meritorious acts understanding their nature, he succeeds, by such righteousness, in cleansing himself from sin even as a piece of dirty cloth is washed clean by some saline substance.

sa: सुरापो वारुणीमुष्णां पीत्वा पापाद् विमुच्यते॥ तया स काये निर्दग्धे मृत्युं वा प्राप्य शुद्ध्यति। लोकांश्च लभते विप्रो नान्यथा लभते हि सः॥
en: A drinker of spirituous liquors becomes purified by drinking hot spirit. He is purified by his death, brought on by that hot drink, in the other world. A Brahmana stained by such a sin attains regions of felicity by such a course, and such a course only, and not by any other.

sa: तस्यैतानि च कर्माणि तथान्यानि च कौरव। क्षत्रियस्येत्यतो जातमिदं कौतूहलं मम॥
en: These and many others are his feats. O descendant of Kuru, my curiosity has been kindled in this respect, because they were performed by a Kshstriya.

sa: जम्बुक उवाच अहो मन्दीकृतः स्नेहो गृध्रेणेहाल्पबुद्धिना। पुत्रस्नेहाभिभूतानां युष्माकं शोचतां भृशम्॥
en: Alas, the love which you entertain for your dead child, and manifested in your sorrowing cyes and mournful looks, has been lessened by that foolish vulture.

sa: सा त्वमेतान्यकार्याणि कार्यापेक्षा व्यवस्यसि। अविज्ञानेन वा युक्ता मिथ्याज्ञानेन वा पुनः॥
en: Do you commit all these sinful deeds, actuated by the motive of performing a particular object? Do you do these from ignorance or from perverted intelligence.

sa: अध्यापयेदधीयीत याजयेत यजेत वा। न वृथा प्रतिगृह्णीयान च दद्यात् कथंचना॥
en: A Brahmana should teach, study, officiate at other people's sacrifices, and offer sacrifices himself. He should not give away uselessly or accept other people's gifts uselessly.

sa: आत्रेयश्चेन्द्रदमनो ह्यहते विविधं धनम्। दत्त्वा लोकान् ययौ धीमाननन्तान् स महीपतिः॥
en: Aftri's royal and highly intelligent son Indradamana, having given various kinds of wealth to a deserving person, acquired various regions of felicity in the next world,

sa: दुष्कृते सुकृते चापि न जन्तुर्नियतो भवेत्। नित्यं मन:समाधाने प्रयतेत विचक्षणः॥
en: No creature is perpetually subject to the fruits of his good or bad acts. The wise man should always try to collect and concentrate his mind.

sa: सोऽतिथिर्वचनं तस्य श्रुत्वा धर्माभिभाषिणः। प्रोवाच वचनं श्लक्ष्णं प्राज्ञो मधुरया गिरा॥
en: Bhishma said, Gifted with great wisdom, the guest hearing this speech of his host which was consistent with virtue, said these sweet words in melodious voice.

sa: स्तवराजमिमं कृत्वा रुद्राय दधिरे मनः। सर्वदोषापहं पुण्यं पवित्रं च यशस्विनः॥
en: By reciting the best of hyinns that can cleanse every sin and that is highly sacred and purifying, highly illustrious persons set their hearts on Rudra.

sa: अष्टावक्र उवाच परदारनहं भद्रे न गच्छेयं कथंचन॥ दूषितं धर्मशास्त्रज्ञैः परदाराभिमर्शनम्।
en: Ashtavakra said O blessed lady, I never approach another's wife. One's union with another man's wife is condemned by persons conversant with the scriptures on morality.

sa: तां वज्र भार्गवः श्रीमांश्च्यवनस्यात्मसम्भवः। ऋचीक इति विख्यातो विपुले तपसि स्थितः॥
en: The illustrious son of Chyavana, known by the name of Richika, of the family of Bhrigu, gifted with austere penance's, sought the hand of this lady.

sa: आद्यन्ते निधनं चैव कर्म चातीत्य सर्वशः। चतुर्विधस्य भूतस्य सर्वस्येशाः स्वयम्भुवः॥
en: Transcending birth, and death, and distinctions and all acts, they are the lords of the four kinds of creatures, and are the equals of Self-create himself.

sa: बालवृद्धसहस्राणि सदा संत्यज्य बान्धवाः। दिनानि चैव रात्रीश्च दुःखं तिष्ठन्ति भूतले॥
en: It is always seen that casting off thousands of kinsmen, young and old kinsmen pass their nights and days in grief, rolling on the naked earth.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच शृणु पुत्र यथा ह्येष पुरुषः शाश्वतोऽव्ययः। अक्षयश्चाप्रमेयश्च सर्वगश्च निरुच्यते॥
en: Brahman said Listen, O son, as to how that Soul is indicated. He is eternal and immutable. He is undecaying and immeasurable. He pervades all things.

sa: स वै तस्मावस्थायां सर्वत्यागकृतः सुखम्। निरिच्छस्त्यजति प्राणान् ब्राह्मीं संविशते तनुम्॥
en: He enjoys, in that state, the happiness which follows Renunciation. Having thoroughly controlled his desires, he casts off his life-breaths and merges into the Brahmic body.

sa: चिताधूमेन नीलेन संरज्यन्ते च पादपाः। श्मशाने च निराहारा: प्रतिनर्दन्ति देहिनः॥
en: The trees on the crematorium are appearing dark for the blue smoke of the funeral pyres. Stricken with hunger the carnivorous animals are yelling in rage.

sa: श्रावयामास चन्द्रस्तं विरूपाक्षं पुरातनम्। यथा शापः पुरा दत्तो ब्रह्मणा राजधर्मणः॥
en: The king of the gods further recited to Virupaksha the old story of the course imprecated by the Grandfather upon that best of birds named Rajdharman.

sa: एतस्मात् कारणात् प्रज्ञां मृगयन्ते पृथग्विधाम्। प्रज्ञालाभो हि भूतानामुत्तमः प्रतिभाति मे॥
en: For these reasons men try to acquire wisdom of various sorts. It appears to me that of all acquisitions that of wisdom is the most precious.

sa: धर्मेण वेदाध्ययनं वेदान्तानां तथैव च। ज्ञानार्थानां च जिज्ञासा श्रेय एतदसंशयम्॥
en: The study of the Vedas, and their branches, according to the well-known rules, and all enquiries and pursuits leading to the acquisition of knowledge,-are, forsooth excellent.

sa: सत्यस्य वचनं श्रेयः सत्यज्ञानं तु दुष्करम्। यद् भूतहितमत्यन्तमेतत् सत्यं ब्रवीम्यहम्॥
en: Truthfulness of speech is excellent. The knowledge of truth is, however, every difficult of acquisition. I hold that as truth which is highly beneficial to creatures.

sa: पश्य चाल्पेन कालेन निश्चयान्वेषणेन च॥ प्रसादं शङ्करात् प्राप्य दुःखिताः सुखमाप्नुवन्।
en: See, how within only a short time, through their firmness of resolution, they gained the grace of Shankara, and their sorrows removed, they were made happy.

sa: वायोः स्पर्शो रसोऽङ्ग्यश्च ज्योतिषो रूपमुच्यते। आकाशप्रभवः शब्दो गन्धो भूमिगुणः स्मृतः॥
en: Touch is said to be attribute of the wind; taste of water; form of light. Sound originate from ether, and scent is the property of earth.

sa: सा तु राजसुता स्मृत्वा भर्तुर्वचनमादितः। तथेति लज्जमाना सा तमुवाच द्विजर्षभम्॥
en: Finding him determined, that lady, recollecting the directions given to her by her husband, but filled with shame, said to that excellent Brahmana Be it so.

sa: भीष्म उवाच दैवं पौर्वाह्निकं कुर्यादपराह्वे तु पैतृकम्। मङ्गलाचारसम्पन्नः कृतशौचः प्रयत्नवान्॥
en: Bhishma said Having purified oneself and then performed the well known auspicious rites, one should carefully perform all acts relating to the Pitris in the afternoon.

sa: न चात्र परिहारोऽस्ति कालस्पृष्टस्य कस्यचित्॥ सूक्ष्माणां महतां चैव भूतानां परिपच्यताम्।
en: Every one is attacked here by Time. Nothing among subtile or gross beings can escape from Time's away. All things are being cooked in Time's pot.

sa: ततोऽभ्यनुज्ञां सम्प्राप्य स्तुतो मतिमतां वरः। शिवमेभिः स्तुवन् देवं नामभिः पुष्टिवर्धनैः॥
en: By praising with these names which increase one's auspiciousness the great lord of blessedness, a worshipper of devoted soul and pure heart gains his own self.

sa: श्रोत्रादीनि च पश्यन्ति स्वं स्वमात्मानमात्मना। सर्वज्ञः सर्वदर्शी च सर्वज्ञस्तानि पश्यति॥
en: The senses cannot themselves apprehend their respective forms. The Soul is omniscient. It sees all things. Being omniscient, it is the Soul that sees the senses.

sa: कृतघ्नः पुरुषव्याघ्र मनसेदमचिन्तयत्। अयं बकपतिः पार्श्वे मांसराशिः स्थितो महान्॥ इमं हत्वा गृहीत्वा च यास्येऽहं समाभिद्रुतम्॥
en: Ungrateful as he was, O foremost of men, he thus thought.-This prince of cranes, so large and having a heap of flesh, is by my side. Killing and bagging him, I shall leave this place and go away quickly.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तत: पक्षी पर्णान्यास्तीर्य भूतले। यथाशक्त्या हि पर्णेन ज्वलनार्थं दुतं ययौ॥
en: Thus addressed, the bird collected a number of dry leaves on the ground, and taking a leaf in his beaks quickly went away for fetching fire.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तु देवेन्द्रं दुःखादाकुलितेन्द्रियः। न प्रसीदति मे देवः किमेतदिति चिन्तयन्॥
en: Having said these words to the king of the celestials, I became stricken with grief thinking that Mahadeva had not been propitiated despite my severe austerities.

sa: स्व्युरुवाच कौमारं ब्रह्मचर्ये मे कन्यैवास्मि न संशयः। पत्नी कुरुष्व मां विप्र श्रद्धां विजहि मा मम॥
en: The lady said I have, since my maidenhood adopted the vow of celibacy. Do not doubt it. I am still a maid. Do you make me your wife. O Brahmana, do not kill this devotion of mine to you.

sa: वायुरुवाच अहमप्येवमेव त्वां कुर्वाण: शाल्मले रुषा। आत्मना यत्कृतं कृच्छ्रे शाखानामपकर्षणम्॥
en: The Wind said-Filled with anger, O Shalmali, I would have done to you exactly what you have done to yourself by cutting off all your branches.

sa: अनेन हि समाविष्टो वृत्रो धर्मभृतां वरः॥ व्यजृभत ततः शक्रस्तस्मै वज्रमवासृजत्।
en: It was by him that Vritra, that foremost of virtuous persons, was possessed when he yawned. It was then that Shakra discharged his thunderbolt at him.

sa: त्वगध्यात्ममिति प्राहुस्तत्त्वबुद्धिविशारदाः। स्पर्शमेवाधिभूतं तु पवनश्चाधिदैवतम्॥
en: The skin is Spiritual; touch is its Elemental; and Wind is its Accidental.

sa: स च तां मन्त्रवत्पूजां प्रत्यगृह्णाद् यथाविधि। प्रतिगुह्य तु तां पूजां जनकाद् द्विजसत्तमः॥ गां चैव समनुज्ञाय राजानमनुमान्य च। पर्यपृच्छन्महातेजा राज्ञः कुशलमव्ययम्॥
en: The ascetic accepted that worship offered with due rites and Mantras. That foremost of twice-born ones, having thus accepted the worship offered by the king, and taking the kine also that were presented to him, then saluted the king, gifted with great energy, he next enquired after the king's welfare and prosperity.

sa: अयुतानि च चन्द्रार्कानपश्यं दिवि केशव॥ ततोऽहमस्तुवं देवं विश्वस्य जगतः पतिम्।
en: I saw countless suns and moons also in the sky, O Keshava. I then lauded the illustrious Lord of everything, the Great Master of the universe.

sa: मुदितः शुचिरभ्येति सर्वतो निर्भयः सदा। न हि दुश्चरितं किंचिदात्मनोऽन्येषु पश्यति॥
en: A pure-hearted person is always filled with cheerfulness and has no fear from any where. Such a person never sees his own misconduct in other persons.

sa: नरः पापसमाचारस्त्यक्तव्यो दूरतो बुधैः। आत्मानं योऽभिसंधत्ते सोऽन्यस्य स्यात् कथं हितः।।१३।
en: Indeed, a wicked man should be shunned from a distance by the wise, for he who injures his ownself cannot be expected to do others good.

sa: मणिभद्र उवाच सदा धर्मफलं राज्यं सुखानि विविधानि च। फलान्येवायमनातु कायक्लेशविवर्जितः॥
en: The fruits of virtue are always kingdom and happiness of various sorts. Let this one enjoy those fruits, always freed from all sorts of physical sufferings.

sa: अन्तर्हितः प्रभावं तु दर्शयित्वा शुकस्तदा॥ गुणान् संत्यज्य शब्दादीन् पदमभ्यगमत् परम्।
en: Having renounced all the attributes of sound, etc., and showing his Yoga-power in the manner of his disappearance, Shuka in this way acquired the highest station.

sa: अवाचिनोति कर्माणि न च सम्प्रचिनोति ह। समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मैत्रायणगतिश्चरेत्॥
en: He who exhausts his merits without trying to hoard them up, who considers all creatures equally and cherishes friendship for the entire universe, attains to Brahma.

sa: कुण्डधार उवाच नाहं धनानि याचामि ब्राह्मणाय धनप्रदा अन्यमेवाहमिच्छामि भक्तायानुग्रहं कृतम्॥
en: Indeed, Kundadhara said,-I do not, O giver of riches, beg for wealth on behalf of this Brahmana. I desire the bestowed of another favour upon him.

sa: एतया शुभया बुद्ध्या नैष्ठिकं व्रतमास्थितः॥ न तत्र सूर्यस्तपति न सोमोऽभिविराजते। न वायुर्वाति देवेशे तपश्चरति दुश्चरम्॥
en: With such an auspicious understanding, he observes a very superior vow which is the embodiment of holiness. The Sun warms not and Soma does not adorn the region where he lives practising austerest penances. There the wind blows not.

sa: अस्मत्तस्ते भयं नास्ति समयं प्रतिपालय। सुखी भव निराबाधः स्वस्थचेता निरामयः॥
en: You have no fear from us. Wait quietly. Be happy, Be shorn of all sorrow. Let your heart be cheerful. May you not suffer from illness.

sa: ब्राह्मणप्रभवो यज्ञो ब्राह्मणार्पण एव च। अनुयज्ञं जगत् सर्वं यज्ञश्चानुजगत् सदा॥
en: Sacrifices have the Brahmanas for their progenitor, and truly they depend upon the Brahmanas. The whole universe depends upon sacrifices, and sacrifice depends upon the universe.

sa: तुलाधार उवाच वक्ष्यामि जाजले वृत्तिं नास्मि ब्राह्मण नास्तिकः। न यज्ञं च विनिन्दामि यज्ञवित् तु सुदुर्लभः॥४॥
en: Tuladhara said I shall now describe the topic of the means of livelihood. I am not, O Brahmana, an atheist. I do not speak against Sacrifices. The man, however, is very rare who is truly an adept in sacrifice.

sa: त्रस्तं विपण्णमुद्विग्नं भयार्तं व्याधितं कृशम्। हतस्वं व्यसनार्तं च नित्यमाश्वासयन्ति ते॥
en: They always used to assure and cheer up the agitated, the cheerless, the anxious, the terrified, the diseased, the emaciated, the ; robbed, and the afflicted.

sa: कल्याणमनुकर्तव्यं पुरुषेण बुभूषता। ये सुगन्धीनि सेवन्ते तथागन्धा भवन्ति ते॥ ये दुर्गन्धीनि सेवन्ते तथागन्धा भवन्ति ते!
en: One who wishes to acquire prosperity should do all that yields blessedness. They who live amidst fragrance themselves become fragrant by virtue thereof. They, on the other hand, who live in the midst of foul smell themselves become foui.

sa: एवं तवोग्रं हि तप उपदेशेन नाशितम्। पुरोहितत्वमुत्सृज्य यतस्व त्वं पुनर्भवे॥
en: Your austere penances were all destroyed by the instructions you gave me. Removing your present office of priest, do you try to regain a superior birth.

sa: त्रासयन्निव देवेन्द्र वाग्भिस्तक्षसि मामिह॥ संयते मयि नूनं त्वमात्मानं बहू मन्यसे।
en: You cut me to the quick with your words, and you seem deterinined to terrorise me. Indeed, finding me calm, you think very highly of you.

sa: एवमुक्ते मया पार्थ भवे चार्तिविनाशने। चराचरं जगत् सर्वं सिंहनादं तदाकरोत्॥
en: After I had said these words, O Partha, to Bhava, that remover of grief and pain, the universe, both mobile and immobile, roared like a lion.

sa: चरुद्वयमिदं चैव मन्त्रपूतं शुचिस्मिते। त्वं च सा चोपभुञ्जीतं ततः पुत्राववाप्स्यथः॥
en: O sweetlysmiling lady, both she and you shall have to partake of these two sacrificial offerings (charu) consecrated with hymns, and then you shall get sons.

sa: नोपसर्पद् विमुञ्चद् वा शशिनं दृश्यते तमः। विसृजंश्योपसर्पश्च तद्वत् पश्य शरीरिणम्॥
en: It is not distinctly seen how Rabu approaches and leaves the moon. Likewise the Soul cannot be seen how it leaves one body and enters another.

sa: आस्थितस्तमहं मार्गमसूयिष्यामि कं कथम्। निन्द्यमानः प्रशस्तो वा हृष्येऽहं केन हेतुना॥
en: I now follow the path of righteousness. Decried by others, why shall I be annoyed with them, or lauded by others, why shall I be pleased?

sa: सहस्रं चैव वर्षाणां निपत्य नरकं वसेत्॥ तस्मान्नैवावगर्खेत नैव जातु निपातयेत्।
en: By slaying a Brahmana one undergoes the torments of hell for a thousand years. No one should, therefore, speak ill of a Brahmana or slay him.

sa: एतद्धि योगं योगानां किमन्यद् योगलक्षणम्। विज्ञाय तद्धि मन्यन्ते कृतकृत्या मनीषिणः॥
en: This is called the Yoga of the Yogins. What else is it? Knowing it, they who are gifted with wisdoin consider themselves as crowned with Success.

sa: तत्राप्यनेकधा वेदान् भेत्स्यते तपसान्वितः॥ कृष्णे युगे च सम्प्राप्ते कृष्णवर्णो भविष्यसि।
en: In that age also, gifted with austere penances, you will divide the Vedas into various classes. Indeed, in that dark age, your complexion will become dark.

sa: करोति वा स रूपाणि धारयत्यपि पर्वतम्। गोरूपं च महादेवो हस्त्यश्वोष्ट्रखराकृतिः॥
en: He assumes the forms of Chasas and of mountains also. O son, Mahadeva assumes the forms of kine and elephants and horses and camels and asses.

sa: सत्कृतश्च तथाऽऽत्रेयः शिष्येभ्यो ब्रह्म निर्गुणम्। उपदिश्य तदा राजन् गतो लोकाननुत्तमान्॥
en: The Rishi Atreya respected of all, attained, O king, to the excellent celestial regions by importing the knowledge of the limitless Supreme Being to his pupils.

sa: भीमसेन उवाच ददानि ते ग्रामवरांश्चतुर्दश प्रियाख्याने सारथे सुप्रसन्नः। दासीशतं चापि रथांश्च विंशति यदर्जुनं वेदयसे विशोक॥
en: Bhima said For this welcome news, O charioteer, with unfeigned pleasure I grant you fourteen choice villages; and O Vishoka, as you bring me the tidings of Arjuna, I also present you a hundred female slaves and twenty chariots.

sa: शोणितानॊ महाकायो राक्षसो भीमदर्शनः। अमर्षाच्छोणितोद्गारी शुशुभे रावणानुजः॥ नीलाञ्जनचयप्रख्यः ससंध्य इव तोयदः। युद्धायाभिमुखो भीमो मनश्चके निशाचरः॥
en: That huge-bodied Rākşasa, younger brother of Ravana, terrible in appearance, resembling a mass of deep black collyrium, and covered all over with blood, appeared like an evening cloud; and (once more) made up his mind to appear in battle.

sa: आगमिष्यामि तद् गृह्य यदि तिष्ठति भारत। ततः सभां करिष्यामि पाण्डवस्य यशस्विनीम्॥ मनः प्रह्लादिनी चित्रां सर्वरत्नभूषिताम्। अस्ति बिन्दुसरस्युग्रा गदा च कुरुनन्दन॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, if it still exists there, I shall come back with it. I shall then build a renowned, delightful and beautiful a assembly-hall for the Pandavas, which will be adorned with all gems gems and jewels. O descendant of Kuru, there is also a club in the Bindu lake.

sa: पृथिव्यां ये च पुरुषा राजन्पौरुषमागताः। सर्वेषां भविता तत्र संक्षयः सर्वकोपजः॥
en: O king! all those men, who are proud of manliness, being incensed with great ire on the occasion of this sacrifice, shall bring ruin upon all.

sa: अव्यक्तस्तु न जानीते पुरुषो ज्ञः स्वभावतः। न मत्तः परमोऽस्तीति नित्यमेवाभिमन्यते॥
en: Unmanifest Nature cannot know anything, while Purusha, by his nature, is endued with knowledge.—There is nothing higher than myself, the Soul is always conscious of it.

sa: अथोक्तस्तु मया राजन् राजा विश्वावसुस्तदा। श्रूयतां यद् भवानस्मान् प्रश्न सम्पृष्टवानिह॥
en: Having said all this, O king, to king Vishvavasu, I then addressed him, saying, Listen now to the answers that I give to your several questions.

sa: त्वां चैवंविधं ज्ञात्वा स्वयं पाकशासनः। आगन्ता कुण्डलार्थाय कवचं चैव भिक्षितुम्॥
en: The vanquisher (of the Asura) Paka, who is well aware of this, will come to you in person, in order to beg your ear-rings and armour.

sa: इदानीं च विजानामि यथा सौम्य सुरेश्वरैः। वधार्थ रावणस्येह पिहितं पुरुषोत्तमम्॥
en: O gentle one, I have heard from the celestials, (that you are) the excellent Puruşa in the guise (of a man) for the destruction of Rävaņa.

sa: श्यामा पद्मपलाशाक्षी मृदुभाषा च मे प्रिया। नूनं वसन्तमासाद्य परित्यक्ष्यति जीवितम्॥
en: Surely shall my dear wife of a slender make, having eyes like lotus-petals and of sweet accents renounce her life at the appearance of this spring?

sa: सर्वासां या तु मातृणां नारी क्रोधसमुद्भवा। धात्री स्वपुत्रवत् स्कन्दं शूलहस्ताभ्यरक्षत॥
en: That lady amongstst the mothers who was born of anger kept watch over Skanda with a spike in hand as a mother guards her own child.

sa: त्रिविष्टपगता राजन् सुरभी प्रारुदत् किल। गवां माता पुरा तात तामिन्द्रोऽन्वकृपायत॥
en: O king, O child, in the days of yore Surabhi, the mother of cows, was once weeping in the celestials regions. Indra took compassion on her.

sa: ततो भग्ना नृपतयो हन्यमाना दिशो ययुः॥ अवीर्या वीर्यसंदिग्धाः सामात्याः पापकारिणः।
en: At length those wicked kings, meeting with slaughter, broke and fled in all directions, together with their adherents, bereft of vigour, and confidence in their strength.

sa: गच्छ सौम्य शिवं मार्ग कार्यस्यास्य विवृद्धये। अहं त्वानुगमिष्यामि सरथो दण्डकावनम्॥
en: O you of auspicious look, do you proceed towards the forest of Dandaka to compass this end of mine; I shall follow you in my chariot,

sa: सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत्। सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निरिवावृताः॥
en: Man must not, O son of Kunti abandon his natural duties, however bad they might be-for all actions are enveloped by error as fire by smoke.

sa: यावल्लोके मनुष्यास्त्वां कथयिष्यन्ति पार्थिव। तावत् कीर्तिश्च लोकाश्च स्थास्यन्ति तव शाश्वताः।।
en: O king, as long as men will speak of you on earth, so long will your glory endure and eternal region would be reserved for you.

sa: राजोवाच अनुग्रहमिमं मन्ये श्येन यन्माभियाचसे। तस्मात् तेऽद्य प्रदास्यामि स्वमांसं तुलयाधृतम्॥
en: The King said : O hawk, I consider your this request as a favour. I shall give you my own flesh weighing it against the pigeon.

sa: तस्य शौचममृष्यन्तस्ते सर्वे सहजातयः। चालयन्ति स्म तां बुद्धिं वचनैः प्रश्रयोत्तरैः॥
en: Unable to bear the purity of his conduct, the other jackals tries to make him change his resolution by addressing him in the following humble words

sa: न संशयमनारुह्य नरो भद्राणि पश्यति। संशयं पुनरारुह्य यदि जीवति पश्यति॥
en: The man who has never met with any calamity can never have prosperity. This is seen in the life of one who has passed through calamities.

sa: अथ संधाय वायव्यमस्रमस्रविदां वरः॥ व्यधमत् कालमेघं तं कर्णो वैकर्तनो वृषः।
en: Then that foremost of all persons versed in the use of weapons, viz., Karna, the son of Vikartana, discharging the Vayavya weapon destroyed that blue cloud.

sa: स्मयन्निव ततः कर्णो दिव्यमस्रमुदैरयत्॥ ततः सोऽस्रेण शैलेन्द्रो विक्षिप्तौ वै न्यनश्यत।
en: Then smiling, Karna invoked into existence a celestial weapon. Then that foremost of mountains, cut and thrown off by that weapons of Karna, was completely destroyed.

sa: प्रतिग्रहं गृहीत्वा यः पुनर्ददति साधवे। फलानां फलमश्नाति तदा दत्त्वा च भारत॥ ससमुद्रगुहा तेन सशैलवनकानना। चतुरन्ता भवेद् दत्त पृथिवी नात्र संशयः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, he who, having accepted a gift, gives it away immediately to a person who is virtuous and honest, obtains great merit. He certainly obtains the fruit of giving away the whole earth to her utmost limits with her oceans, seas and caves, her mountains and forests and woods.

sa: एतस्मात् कारणाद् घोरो वर्तते स्वजनक्षयः। दैवाद् वा पुरुषव्याघ्र तव चापनयानृप॥
en: For this reason, O foremost of men, a dreadful destruction of men is taking place, brought about by Destiny or by your wicked policy, O king.

sa: यश्च शास्त्रमधीयीत ऋषिभिः परिपालितम्। स गच्छेद् ब्रह्मणो लोकमव्ययं च नरोत्तम॥
en: He who studies this Shastra observed by the Rishis, is sure, O king, to attain to the eternal region of Brahman that is full of happiness.

sa: पुत्रः पितृवधं कृत्वा पिता पुत्रवधं तथा। निसद्वेगो बृहद्वादी न निन्दामुपलप्स्यते॥
en: Sons having killed their fathers and fathers having killed their sons will incur no opprobrium by doing it; and they ever will take glory in them.

sa: कवचेन समायुक्तः कुण्डलाभ्यां च मानद। अवध्यस्त्वं रणेऽरीणामिति विद्धि वचो मम॥
en: O bestower of honours, arrayed in your armour and ear-rings you will be unslayable by your enemies in battle. Know these my words to be certain.

sa: राजानो राजपुत्राश्च नानाजनपदेश्वराः। शिशुपालो महावीर्यः सह पुत्रेण भारत॥ आगच्छत् पाण्डवेयस्य यज्ञं समरदुर्मदः। रामश्चैवानिरुद्धश्च कश्च सहसारण:॥
en: Various other kings and potentates ruling over various countries the greatly effulgent and invincible in battle king Sisupala with his son, o descendant of Bharata, (all these kings) came to the sacrifice of the Pandavas, Rama, Aniruddha, Kanaka, Sarana.

sa: स्मृत्वा वियोगजं दुःखं त्यज स्नेहं प्रिये जने। अतिस्नेहपरिष्वङ्गाद् वर्तिरार्दापि दह्यते॥
en: Remembering the grief consequent on separation do you forsake your attachment to your dear one. Out of an excess of oil even the wick burn itself.

sa: स भीमसेनाभिहतस्तवात्मजः पपात संकम्पितदेहबन्धनः। सुपुष्पितो मारुतवेगताडितो वने यथा शाल इवावघूर्णितः॥
en: Struck by Bhimnasena, your son dropped down, his bodying trembling all over, like a gigantic Shala in the forest, decked with flowers, uprooted by a tempest.

sa: शृणुष्वानवशेषेण वदतो मम पार्थिवा य आत्मनो दुश्चरितादशुभं प्राप्नुयानरः। न स कालं न वा देवानेनसा गन्तुमर्हति॥
en: Listen to the end of my speech in detail regarding this matter; that man, who meets with disasters owing to his own bad acts, should not, properly speaking, lay the fault on time or luck nor on the gods.

sa: बालिशस्त्वं नरश्रेष्ठ गम्यतां स्वपुरं पुनः। याजने भगवाशक्तस्त्रैलोक्यस्यापि पार्थिव ॥ अवमानं कथं कर्तुं तस्य शक्ष्यामहे वयम्।
en: You are ignorant, O foremost of men. Do you speedily retrace your steps. And, O king, that adorable one is competent to officiate at the sacrifice itself of the three worlds, how can we then contribute to his dishonour?'

sa: अथ वस्त्राण्यलङ्कारं भक्ष्यं पेयं च शोभनम्॥ अददन्मुदितो राजन् पूजयित्वा द्विजोत्तमान्। तस्मिंस्तीर्थवरे रामः प्रदाय विविधं वसु॥
en: Distributing various sorts of wealth in that best of tirthas, Rama also gladly gave away milch cows, vehicles, beds, ornaments, food and drink of the best kinds, O king, to many foremost of Brahmanas, after having adored them dully.

sa: गुणैः समुदितान् दृष्ट्वा पौराः पाण्डुसुतांस्तदा। कथयांचक्रिरे तेषां गुणान् संसत्सु भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, seeing the sons of Pandu, endued with all accomplishments, the citizens began to speak to their accomplishments in every place of resort.

sa: येन केन तु मार्गेण तराम वरुणालयम्। हतेति नगरी लङ्का वानरैरुपधार्यताम्॥
en: Let us by any way whatever cross over Varuna's abode. Do you take it for certain that the city of Lankā is subdued by the monkeys.

sa: हैहयस्य तु राजेन्द्र दशसु स्त्रीषु भारत। शतं बभूव पुत्राणां शूराणामनिवर्तिनाम्॥
en: Haihaya, O monarch, had ten wives. Upon them he beget, O Bharata, hundred sons all of whom were heroes who never returned from the battle field.

sa: अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो भूतानामभयं ततः। तस्य मोहाद् विमुक्तस्य भयं नास्ति कुतश्चन॥
en: He who fears no creature and whom no creature fears, can have no fear from any quarter, freed as he is from every form of mistake.

sa: स्वं रूपं च यदा द्रष्टुमिच्छेथास्त्वं नराधिप। संस्मर्तव्यस्तदा तेऽहं वासश्चेदं निवासयेः॥
en: O king of men! when shall you desire to witness your own form, call me back to your mind; and put on these pieces of cloth.

sa: चकार विस्थं कर्ण तव पुत्रस्य पश्यतः। ततो विमनसो राजंस्तावकास्ते महारथाः॥
en: Made him carless in the very presence of your son. Thereupon, O king, O most exalted of the Bharatas, the warriors on your side got dispirited.

sa: यानि माल्यानि देवेषु यानि चैत्ररथे वने। प्रयागे तान्यदृश्यन्त भरद्वाजस्य तेजसा॥
en: And those blossoms that are in the celestial regions, and that bloom in the forest of Caitraratha, became visible in Prayāga at the energy of Bharadvāja.

sa: म्लेच्छाचाराः सर्वभक्षा दारुणाः सर्वकर्मसु। भाविनः पश्चिमे काले मुनष्या नात्र संशयः॥
en: When this age will come, men will certainly adopt the Mlechchha conduct; they will eat all things; they will be free in all their all acts.

sa: इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद् गुह्यतरं मया। विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु॥
en: I have thus declared to you the knowledge which is more mysterious than any other mystery. Reflect on it fully, and then act as you like.

sa: अङ्गादङ्गात् सम्भवसि हृदयादधिजायसे। आत्मा वै पुत्रनामासि स जीव शरदः शतम्॥
en: “You are born of my body; you have sprung from my heart. You are myself in the form of my son. Live for one hundred years."

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच शरतल्पगतं भीष्मं वृद्धं कुरुपितामहम्। उपगम्य महाप्राज्ञः पर्यपृच्छद् युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Approaching Bhishma venerable in years viz., Bhishma, who was then lying on his bed of arrows, the highly wise Yudhishthira put the following questions.

sa: स्तथा ह्यगस्त्यो नारदपर्वतौ च। भृगुर्वसिष्ठाः कश्यपो गौतमश्च विश्वामित्रो जमदग्निश्च राजन्॥
en: There were Shakra, Angirasa the highly learned Kavi, Agastya, Narada and Parvata; and Bhrigu and Vasishtha and Kashyapa and Gautama and Vishvamitra and Jamadagni, O king.

sa: एवं नलं च संदिश्य वासो दत्त्वा च कौरव। नागराजस्ततो राजंस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत।॥
en: O descendant of Kuru! O king! having thus advised Nala and given to him the celestials garment, the monarch of the snakes disappeared then and there.

sa: न चायोधोऽभवत् कश्चिन्मम सैन्ये तु संजय। अल्पदानभृतस्तात तथा चाभृतको नरः॥
en: O Sanjaya, there is none who is not a good warrior, none who receives remuneration less then what he deserves or none who receives no pay.

sa: कोऽन्यो हि पृथिवीं कृत्स्ना जित्वा हि युधि पार्थिवान्। चारयित्वा हयश्रेष्ठमुपागच्छेदृतेऽर्जुनात्।
en: Who else than Arjuna could return after having caused the horse to wander over the whole Earth and after having defeated all the kings in battle?

sa: साभिवाद्य पितुः पादौ शेषाः पूर्वं निवेद्य च। कृताञ्जलिर्वरारोहा नृपतेः पार्श्वमास्थिता।॥
en: And bowing down to the feet of her father and offering him those flowers and garlands, that highly beautiful damsel with joined-hands stood beside the king.

sa: चक्षुषा संजयो राजन् दिव्येनैव समन्वितः। कथयिष्यति ते युद्धं सर्वज्ञश्च भविष्यति॥
en: O king, possessing a possessing a celestial vision Sanjaya will narrate the battle to you. He will possess the knowledge of every thing regarding this battle.

sa: तस्मिन् हते हतं मन्ये पाण्डुसैन्यमशेषतः। प्रतिगृह्य च तामाज्ञां तव पुत्रहस्य पार्थिवाः॥ भीमं प्रच्छादयामासुः शरवर्षेः समन्ततः।
en: When he (Bhimasena) is felled, well may I count upon the Pandu forces as if already slain. Following the behest of your son, all the vassal chiefs (hitting) from all sides, covered Bhima with a thick shower of arrows.

sa: ततः प्रवीरा पार्थानां सर्वे कर्णमपीडयन्। युधामन्युः शिखण्डी च द्रौपदेयाः प्रभद्रकाः॥
en: Afterwards all the best heroes among the Parthas continued to oppress Karna greatly. Thus Yudhamanyu, Shikhandin, the sons of Draupadi, as well as all the Prabhadrakas.

sa: तत: स कवची धन्वी स्तूयमानः सुरर्षिभिः। वन्दिभिर्वन्द्यमानश्च बभौ सूर्य इवोदितः॥
en: Casing his person in shining mail and armed with the bow, Pratarddana, his praises lauded by bards and the celestial Rishi, shone resplendent like the Sun.

sa: हिरण्यशृङ्गः सुमहान् महामणिमयो गिरिः। रम्यं बिन्दुसरो नाम यत्र राजा भगीरथः॥
en: There is a great peak full of many gems and jewels, called Hiranya Shringa. (There is) a charming lake named Bindusara where (once dwelt) king Bhagiratha.

sa: स निर्भिद्य रणे पार्थ सूतपुत्रधनुश्च्युतः। अगच्छद् दारयन् भूमिं चित्रपुलः शिलीमुखः॥
en: That shaft or variegated wing shot from the bow of Suta's son pierced through the son of Pritha and then penetrating the earth went inside it.

sa: यावन्ति तस्या रोमाणि वत्सस्य च युधिष्ठिर। तावद् युगसहस्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते॥
en: O Yudhishthira, he is adored in the celestials region as many thousand Yugas as there are hairs on the bodies of that cow and the calf.

sa: तं तु हत्वा नरपति हैहयास्ते महारथाः। प्रतिजग्मुः पुरी रम्यां वत्सानामकुतोभया:॥
en: Having killed king Haryashva thus, the sons of Haihaya, those great car warriors fearlessly returned to their own charming city in the country of the Vatsas.

sa: विदित्वा च दृढां भक्तिं तां शुके शीलसम्पदम्। प्रीतः क्षिप्रमथो वृक्षममृतेनावसिक्तवान्॥
en: Knowing the great attachment of the parrot to that tree and great high character, Indra, wellpleased, caused the tree to be quickly sprinkled over with nectar.

sa: वाहनानां च विविधाः शाला: शालीक्षुगोरसैः। उपेता भरतश्रेष्ठो व्यादिदेश स धर्मराट्॥
en: The chief of the Bharatas, viz., king Yudhishthria the just, assigned several stables well-filled with different kinds of corn and sugar-cane and milk to the animals.

sa: दिवःस्पृक् सुमहान् केतुः स्यन्दनेऽस्य समुच्छ्रितः।। १७ रक्तोत्तमाङ्गः क्रव्यादो गृध्रः परमभीषणः।
en: A huge standard, touching the very clouds was set upon his chariot. A dreadful vulture of crimson body and flash-eating was the device on his standards.

sa: विदितार्थस्तु वेदानां परिवेद प्रयोजनम्। उद्विजेत् स तु वेदेभ्यो दावाग्नेरिव मानवः॥
en: He who knows the true meaning of the Vedas also understands their true use. He is frightened at the Vedic rites as man at a conflagration.

sa: सौदास उवाच यदि मत्तस्तवायत्तो गुर्वथैः कृत एव सः। यदि चास्मि प्रतिग्राह्यः साम्प्रतं तद् वदस्व मे॥१११!
en: If the object you seck for your preceptor is capable of being placed in your hands by me. If। I be considered as one from whom a gift may be accepted, do you then say what that object is!

sa: किमुक्तवांश्च भगवंस्तन्ममाचक्ष्व सुव्रतः। त्वत्तः श्रोतुं सर्वमिदं परं कौतूहलं हि मे॥
en: O exalted one, O Rishi of excellent vows, what did he tell you? Tell me all. I am filled with great curiosity to hear all this.

sa: अर्जुनश्चापि यचक्रे सिन्धुराजवधं प्रति। तन्मे सर्व समाचक्ष्व कुशलो ह्यसि संजय॥
en: O Sanjaya, skilful as you are in narration, tell me all that in detail which Arjuna did for bringing about the slaughter of the Sindhu king.

sa: स विसृष्टो बलवता बाणो वनाशनिस्वनः। अदारयद् रणे कर्णं वज्रवेगो यथाचलम्॥
en: Discharged by powerful Bhima, that arrow, making a sound like that of a thunderbolt, struck Karna in that battle like the thunderbolt itself clapping a mountain,

sa: मा भूत्ते विफला वाणी मत्प्रसादकृता शुभा। भवतः पुत्रमेकं तु शूलमेतद्भविष्यति॥
en: But in order that your prayer may not go for nothing. I graciously say in your behalf that one of your sons shall sway this dart.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच युधिष्ठिरस्य नृपतेर्दुर्योधनपितुस्तदा। नान्तरं ददृशू राज्ये पुरुषाः प्रणयं प्रति॥
en: The people who lived in the Kuru kingdom could not mark any difference in the cordiality which existed between king Yudhishthira and the father of Duryodhana.

sa: अमर्षितो महेष्वासः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः। नरव्याघ्रः शिनेः पौत्रे द्रोणः किमकरोद् युधि॥
en: What did the fierce bowman Drona, that foremost of all wielders of weapons, inflamed with wrath, do to the grandson of Sini that foremost of men?

sa: विशोक उवाच किं भीम नैनं त्वमिहाशृणोषि विस्फारितं गाण्डिवस्यातिघोरम्। क्रुद्धेन पार्थेन विकृष्यतोऽद्य कचिन्नेमौ तव की विनष्टौ॥
en: Vishoka said Can't you, O Bhima, hear the awful sound of the Gandiva? (or), have those ears of yours lost their sensibility from the effects of the thunder produced by Partha, while out stretching it with fire and fury?

sa: अपराधैर्न तावन्तो भृत्याः शिष्टा नराधिपः। उपघातैर्यथा भृत्या दूषिता निधनं गताः॥
en: A few only of the servants of kings are justly punished for their offences. A great number of them, however, meet with death under false charges.

sa: स्थूणाकर्णभयो जालं शरवर्षमथोल्बणम्। शलभास्त्रमश्मवर्ष समास्थायाहमभ्ययाम्॥
en: I then discharged at him. Sthunakarna, Varuna, Saravarsa, Ulvana, Salava and Asmavarsa weapons.

sa: दानेनतेन तेजस्वी वीर्यवांश्च भवेन्नरः। प्रीतश्च भगवान् सोम इष्टान् कामान् प्रयच्छति॥
en: By making such gifts, a person becomes gifted with great energy and prowess. Wellpleased with him, the divine Soma grants him the fruition of his desires.

sa: एवमस्त्विति तान् देवान् वरुणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। समागम्य ततः सर्वे वरुणं सागरालयम्॥
en: All the celestials then assembled together, made Varuna living in the Ocean the Lord of all the waters, according to the rites sanctioned by the Scriptures.

sa: यदिष्टं क्षत्रबन्धूनां स्वधर्ममनुतिष्ठताम्॥ निधनं तन्मया प्राप्तं को न स्वन्ततरो मया।
en: I have met with that death which is desired by good Kshatriyas observant of the duties of their order. Who is there so fortunate as myself.

sa: ततो दृष्ट्वा कृतातिथ्यमन्योन्यं ते वनौकसः। सहिता भरतश्रेष्ठ निषेदुः परिवार्य तम्॥
en: Seeing him those dwellers of the forest united together did him the rites of hospitality and then sat down surrounding him, O chief among the Bharatas.

sa: नैव पश्येन्न शृणुयादवाच्यं जातु कस्यचित्। ब्राह्मणानां विशेषेण नैव ब्रूयात् कथंचन॥
en: The mendicant should never mind the evil deeds of any person. He should never hear vilifications of others. He should especially guard against reviling a Brahmana.

sa: अपि गाथां पुरा गीतां जनकेन वदन्त्युत। निर्द्वन्द्वेन विमुक्तेन मोक्षं समनुपश्यता॥
en: A verse was sung (of old) by Janaka who was liberated from the pairs of opposites, from desire and enjoyments, and observed the religion of Moksha.

sa: अदुष्टस्य हि संत्यागः सत्पथे निरतस्य च निर्दहेदपि शक्रस्य द्युतिं धर्मविरोधवान्॥
en: But the renunciation of the honest ever constant in a righteous course, in consequence of its being opposed to virtue, destroys the splendour of Sakra himself.

sa: निषादी पञ्चपुत्रा तु जातुषे तत्र वेश्मनि। कारणाभ्यागता दग्धा सह पुत्रैरनागसा॥
en: For some reasons a Nishada woman came to the house of lac and though (she was) innocent, she was burnt to death with her five sons.

sa: भीष्म उवाच दानेन तपसा यज्ञैरद्रोहेण दमेन च। ब्राह्मणप्रमुखा वर्णाः क्षेममिच्छेयुरात्मनः॥
en: “By gifts, by penances, by sacrifices, by peacefulness, and by self-control, all the castes led by the Brahmanas should, on such occasions, seek their own behoof.

sa: तं निकृत्तं शरं दृष्ट्वा कृत्तभोगमिवोरगम्। अतिकायो भृशं क्रुद्धः पञ्च बाणान्समादधे॥ ताशरान्संप्रचिक्षेप लक्ष्मणाय निशाचरः। तानप्राप्ताशितैर्बाणैश्चिच्छेद भरतानुजः॥
en: Seeing the shaft severed, like a serpent having its person cut off, Atikāya waxing exceedingly enraged, took up five arrow; and the nightranger discharged them at Lakşmaņa. Thereat Bharata's younger brother cut off the approaching arrows with whetted shafts.

sa: संजय उवाच ततो दुर्योधनो राजा लोहितायति भास्करे। संग्रामरभसो भीमं हन्तुकामोऽभ्यधावत॥
en: Sanjaya said Then when the sun assumed a crimsons hue, king Duryodhana, ardently longing for battle, rushed towards Bhima, out of a desire for slaying him.

sa: कृतार्थमथ चात्मानं मन्यते कालचोदितः। ते तु सर्वेऽद्य सम्प्राप्ता मम नाराचगोचरम्॥
en: He also thinks himself to be already crowned with success, being impelled by Fate. But today, all these warriors, coming within the reach of my Narachas.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा क्रोधताम्राक्षः सात्यकिस्त्वाददे गदाम्॥ विनिःश्वस्य यथा सर्पः प्रणिधाय रथे धनुः।
en: Hearing those words Satyaki with his eyes coppery in rage, laid his bow aside on the car and breathing like a snake he grasped his mace.

sa: संचिन्तयामि कौन्तेयं रहो जिष्णुं जनार्दन। अतीव दुःखभागी स सततं पाण्डुनन्दनः॥
en: I always, O Janardana, think, when I am withdrawn from business, of Kunti's son Jishnu. The lot of that delighter of the Pandus is highly miserable.

sa: यत् पुरा मत्सरी भूत्वा पाण्डवानवमन्यसे। तस्य पापस्य गान्धारे पश्य व्यसनमागतम्॥
en: O son of Gandhari, inflated with pride in days past, you disregarded the sons of Pandu, Reap now the dire fruit of that act of yours.

sa: अतदर्ह महाप्राज्ञं जीवितार्थेऽभिसंस्थितम्। दृष्ट्वा कस्य न दुःखं स्याद् धर्मात्मानं युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Beholding that virtuous Yudhishthira of great wisdom, undeserving of such a plight and serving another for maintenance who is there that is not overtaken by grief.

sa: याचमानं च यन्मोहाद् दाशार्हमवमन्यसे। उलूकस्य समादेशं यद् ददासि च हृष्टवत्॥
en: You also despised the descendant of the Dasharnas (Krishna) when be begged you (for peace). Filled with joy, you sent Uluka to us with your messages.

sa: कामं त्वया परित्यक्ता गमिष्यामि स्वमाश्रमम्। इमं तु बालं संत्यक्तुं नार्हस्यात्मजमात्मनः॥
en: Cast off from you, I am ready to go back to the hermitage. But you should not cast off this child who is your own son.

sa: इदं त्वाश्चर्यभूतं मे यदिमे पाण्डवास्त्वया। अपकृष्टाः सतां मार्गान्प्रन्यन्ते तच्च साध्विति॥
en: It is greatly surprising that though you often lead the Pandavas away from the path of the pious, yet they consider you (Bhima) to be honest.

sa: नान्यथा तां महाबाहो सम्प्रकर्तुमिहार्हसि। परित्यज्य प्रियान् प्राणान् रणे चर विभीतवत्॥
en: O mighty-armed one, it behoves you not to falsify our expectations. Disregardful of your dear life, do you begin to career like a hero in battle.

sa: उत्तरेण विनिष्क्रम्य द्वारेण सह राक्षसैः। प्रविश्यायोधनं घोरं विचिन्वन्त्यो हतं पतिम्॥
en: And coming out by the northern gate along with the Rakssas entering the dreadful arena of battle and searching their slain lord the shedemons cried piteously.

sa: गाधिर्नाम महानासीत् क्षत्रियः प्रथितो भुवि। तस्य पुत्रोऽभवद् राजन् विश्वामित्रः प्रतापवान्॥
en: There was a great Kshatriya, celebrated over the world, by the name of Gadhi. He had a son by the name of Vishvamitra of great prowess.

sa: निशम्य पाण्डुपुत्राणां तदा वै जयिनां स्वनम्। विद्रुतं शिबिरं दृष्ट्वा सायाह्ने राजगृद्धिनः॥ स्थानं नारोचयंस्तत्र ततस्ते ह्रदमभ्ययुः।
en: Hearing the shouts of the victorious sons of Pandu and beholding the camp empty in the evening, those three warriors of our side, desirous of rescuing the king and unable to stand on the field, proceeded towards the lake.

sa: तत् प्रविश्य क्षुधाविष्टो विश्वामित्रो महानृषिः। आहारान्वेषणे युक्तः परं यत्नं समास्थितः॥
en: Stricken with hunger and engaged in search after food, the great Rishi Vishvamitra entered that hamlet and tried his level best to find something to eat.

sa: स्वामिनो गुणदोषाभ्यां भृत्याः स्युर्नात्र संशयः॥ दुष्टं राजानमासाद्य गतास्ते तनया नृप।
en: Servants, forsooth, are affected by the merits and demerits of their masters. O king, having obtained a bad king, your other sons have all been destroyed.

sa: बलं मे प्रजहातीव प्राणाः संत्वरयन्ति च। मर्माणि परितप्यन्ति भ्रान्तचित्तस्तथा ह्यहम्॥
en: My strength is leaving me. My vital airs are about to leave me. The very vitals of my body are being consumed. My understanding is clouded.

sa: युयुत्सुरपि तां सात्रिं स्वगृहे न्यवसत् तदा। वन्द्यमानः स्वकैश्चापि नाभ्यनन्दत् सुदुःखितः। चिन्तयानः क्षयं तीव्र भरतानां परस्परम्॥
en: As regards Yuyutsu, he passed that night in his own house. Possessed by miscry, he could find no delight at the panegyrics with which he was welcomed. He passed the time, thinking of the terrible onslaught of the Bharatas.

sa: उत्तिष्ठते कबन्धोऽत्र सहस्र निहते तु यः। स यूपस्तस्य शूरस्य खादिरोऽशस्त्रिरुच्यते॥
en: The headless trunks that rise up after thousands have been killed from the octagonal stake, made of Khadira wood, for the hero who celebrates that sacrifice.

sa: ये दम्भात्राचरन्ति स्म येषां वृत्तिश्च संयता। विषयांश्च निगृह्णन्ति दुर्गाव्यतितरन्ति ते॥
en: Those, who never practise deceit, those, whose conduct is regulated by wholesome restrictions, and those, who control all worldly desires, succeed in getting over all difficulties.

sa: स च्छिन्नधन्वा विरथः खड्गमादाय चर्म च॥ रथादवातरद् वीरः शैलाग्रादिव केसरी।
en: Deprived of his bow and his car, the brave Nakula, taking up a sword, jumped down from his car like a lion from a mountain suminit.

sa: चक्ररथे हते शल्यः पाण्डवेन महात्मना॥ निजघान ततो राजश्चेदीन् वै पञ्चविंशतिम्।
en: When the two protectors of his car-wheels were (thus) killed by the great son of Pandu, Shalya, O king, slew twenty five warriors among the Chedis.

sa: त्वकृतेऽसौ हतः शेते शरतल्पे प्रतापवान्। गाङ्गेयो रथिनां श्रेष्ठो निहतो याज्ञसेनिना॥
en: It is for you that foremost of car-warriors, viz., the highly powerful son of Ganga, struck down by Yajnasena's son, sleep on a bed of arrows.

sa: अनागतमनर्थं हि सुनयैर्यः प्रबाधयेत्। स न संशयमाप्नोति रोचतां भो व्रजामहे॥
en: He, who resists future evil by the help of good policy, never meets with serious danger. You follow my advice. Lest us all quit this place.

sa: तेषु योधसहस्रेषु तावकेषु परेषु च। एको दुर्योधनो ह्यासीत् पुमानिति मतिर्मम॥
en: Amongst those thousands of warriors on the field, of your side or that of the enemy, it appeared as if Duryodhana was then the only man.

sa: तस्मादेकान्तमुत्सृज्य पूर्वैः पूर्वतरैश्च यः। पन्था निषेवित: सद्भिः स निषेव्यो विजानता॥
en: Therefore, driving away all misgivings regarding the immortality of the soul, the intelligent nian should adopt the path of the righteous of old and older times.

sa: अमन्यत स्थितं ह्येनं प्रहरिष्यन्तमाहवे। अतो न प्राहरत् तस्मै पुनरेव तवात्मजः॥
en: Duryodhana, therefore, thought that he was all right and ready to return the blow. It was, therefore, that your son did not then strike him again.

sa: वने दुःखं च यत् प्राप्तमस्माभिस्त्वत्कृतं महत्॥ विराटनगरे चैव योन्यन्तरगतैरिव। तत् सर्वं पातयाम्यद्य दिष्ट्या दृष्टोऽसि दुर्मति॥
en: Remember the great misfortune suffered by L'S, for you, in the forest, as also in Virata's city, as if we had once more entered the womb! I shall avenge them all to-day. By good luck, I see you to-day!

sa: प्रातिकामी तथा पापो द्रौपद्याः कुशकृद्धतः। भ्रातरस्ते हताः सर्वे शूरा विक्रान्तयोधिनः॥
en: The wretched Pratikamin, who had seized Draupadi by her hair, has been killed! All your brave brothers also, who fought with great velour, have been killed!

sa: अधार्याणि विशीर्णानि वसनानि द्विजातिभिः॥ शूद्रायैव प्रदेयानि तस्य धर्मधनं हि तत्।
en: Torn clothes, which are no longer fit for wear, should be given by the upper three castes to the Shudra. These are the latter's rightful acquisitions.

sa: ततो राजकुले नान्दी संजज्ञे भूयसा पुनः। पुरोहितकुले चैव सम्प्राप्ते ब्राह्मणर्षभे॥
en: After this, the king of Koshala took a minister from the Kshatriya order, and appointed that foremost of Brahmana (viz., the sage Kalakavrikshiya), as his priest.

sa: प्राज्ञाशूरान् महोत्साहान् कर्मसु स्थिरपौरुषान्। मानयन्तः सदा युक्ता विवर्धन्ते गणा नृप॥
en: By receiving properly those who are endued with wisdom, courage and perseverance and who show steady prowess in all kinds of work, the aristocracy grow prosperous.

sa: त्वयैव ससुतेनायं वाक्यवायुसमीरितः। लोभाज्येन स संसिक्तो ज्वलितः पार्थपावकः॥ मधु यः
en: with your You and your son, had with your words fanned the Partha-fire, and covetousness as clarified butter made that fire blaze forth into burning flames.

sa: गुरुतल्पं हि गुर्वर्थं न दूषयति मानवम्। उद्दालक: श्वेतकेतुं जनयामास शिष्यतः॥
en: Knowing the preceptor's wife at the preceptor's behest, does not stain the pupil. The sage Uddalaka caused his son Shvetaketu to be begotten by a disciple.

sa: तस्य शस्त्राणि यावन्ति त्वचं भिन्दन्ति संयुगे। तावतः सोऽश्नुते लोकान् सर्वकामदुहोऽक्षयान्॥
en: In such a case, regions eternal and capable of granting every desire proportionate to the number of arrows he discharges for wounding the enemies, await him.

sa: बाह्ममाभ्यन्तरं चैव पौरजानपदं तथा। चारैः सुविदितं कृत्वा ततः कर्म प्रयोजयेत्॥
en: Knowing properly, through spies, the external conduct and the state of mind of the inhabitants of his city and provinces, he should take the necessary steps.

sa: ततः प्रक्षाल्यमानेषु मत्स्येषु विपुले जले। मुक्त्वा रज्जु प्रमुक्तोऽसौ शीघ्रं सम्प्रतिपत्तिमान्॥
en: They then removed them to a deep, water for washing them, Just then the Shakula known for presence of mind, left the string, and quickly escaped.

sa: ब्रह्मचारी गुरुर्यस्मात् तपस्वी ब्राह्मणश्च सन्॥ अकार्षीः समयभ्रंशमावाभ्यां यः कृतो मिथः।
en: You are a Brahmacharin. You are my preceptor. You are an ascetic and a Brahmana. Yet you have broken the agreement you had made with me.

sa: एतां बुद्धिं विनिश्चित्य भूतानामागतिं गतिम्। पितृपैतामहे वृत्ते शाधि राज्यं यथोचितम्॥
en: Applying your intellect to this, and determining the right and the wrong paths of creatures, follow the course of your forefathers and govern properly your kingdom.

sa: त्र्यम्बक सवितुर्बाहू भगस्य नयने तथा। पूष्णश्च दशनान् क्रुद्धो धनुष्कोट्या व्यशातयत्॥
en: Then the three-eyed Mahadeva, with his bow, broke in anger the arms of Savitri, and plucked out the eyes of Bhaga and the teeth of Pushna.

sa: तस्मै तदहमाचक्षे सर्वं प्रत्यक्षदर्शिवान्। भ्रातंश्च निहतान् सर्वान् सैन्यं च विनिपातितम्॥
en: I had seen everything with my eyes and therefore, told him everything viz., that his brothers had all been killed and that his entire army destroyed.

sa: सुहृद्धिस्तादृशै_नः पुत्रैर्धातृभिरेव च। पाण्डवैश्च हृते राज्ये को नु जीवेत मादृशः॥
en: Shorn of friends, deprived of sons and brothers and seeing his kingdom taken by the Pandavas who is there like me that would desire to live.

sa: बृहस्पतिसवेनेष्ट्वा सुरापो ब्राह्मणः पुनः। समितिं ब्राह्मणो गच्छेदिति वै ब्रह्मणः श्रुतिः॥
