en: By celebrating the sacrifice laid down by Brihaspati, a Brahmana who drinks wine may obtain the region of Brahmana this has been said by Brahma himself.

sa: भीमसेन उवाच अन्यस्यापि न पातव्यं रुधिरं किं पुनः स्वकम्। यथैवात्मा तथा भ्राता विशेषो नास्ति कश्चन॥
en: Bhima replied,-'It is improper to drink the blood of even a stranger, what then need be said about quaffing the blood of one's own self. One's brother, again, is like his own self. There is no difference between them.

sa: संजय उवाच शृणोमि ते नारद वाचमेनां विचित्रार्थी स्त्रजमिव पुण्यगन्धाम्। राजर्षीणां पुण्यकृतां महात्मनां कीर्त्या युक्तानां शोकनिर्णाशनार्थाम्॥
en: I am all attention, ONarada, to this discourse of yours, of excellent sense and perfumed like a garland of flowers,-this discourse regarding the conduct of great royal sages of meritorious deeds and great fame, that can surely remove grief.

sa: माता पिता गुरुर्गोप्ता वह्निर्वैश्रवणो यमः। सप्त राज्ञो गुणानेतान् मनुराह प्रजापतिः॥
en: The lord of all creatures, viz., Manu, has declared that the king has seven attributes : he is mother, father, preceptor, protector, fire, Vaishravana, and Yama.

sa: विसृजास्त्रं परं पार्थ राधेयो ग्रसते शरान्। ततो ब्रह्मास्त्रमत्युग्रं सम्मन्त्र्य समयोजयत्॥
en: Discharge more powerful weapons, O Partha, Karna makes these your arrows powerless." Then duly invoking it with mantras Arjuna set the Brahma weapon on his string.

sa: तमिमं विक्रमं लोके प्रथितं ते यशस्करम्। निवेदयावः कौन्तेय कुरुराजस्य धीमतः॥
en: Proceed, O Kunti's son and describe to the righteous king Yudhishthira your power capable of earning fame for you and which is known in the worlds.

sa: त्वया च महदैश्वर्यं प्राप्तं परपुञ्जय। किंकरा भ्रातरः सर्वे मित्रसम्बन्धिनः सदा॥
en: O subjugator of hostile towns, you too have acquired great affluence. All your brothers are ever obedient to your, as also all your friends and relatives.

sa: नाथवन्तं तु सुहृदः प्रतिषेधन्ति पातकात्। निवर्तते तु लक्ष्मीवान् नालक्ष्मीवान् निवर्तते॥
en: Well-wishers try to restrain a friend from committing sin. He who allows himself to be dissuaded succeeds in gaining prosperity. He, that does otherwise suffers misery,

sa: विमाननात् तयोरेव प्रजा नश्येयुरेव हि। ब्रह्मक्षत्रं हि सर्वेषां वर्णानां मूलमुच्यते॥
en: If they do not respect each other, destruction would befall the people. The Brahmana and the Kshatriya are said to be the creators of all men.

sa: स तस्य ढवतस्त्वेवं संत्रासाज्जातसाध्वसः॥ शाखां हित्वा जवेनाशु मारिः प्रययौ ततः।
en: While the mous, thus spoke, the cat frightened at the mention of the hunter, hastily left the branch of the tree, ran away with great speed.

sa: सहितैश्चापि योद्धव्यमित्येष समयः कृतः॥ अथ कस्मात् परानेव नतो मर्षयसे नृप।
en: The contract was that all of us should fight in a body. Why then, O king, do you suffer our foes to kill thus our soldiers?

sa: यदा तु पाण्डवाः सर्वे सुपरिश्रान्तवाहनाः॥ ततः स्वशिबिरं प्राप्य व्यतिष्ठन्त ससैनिकाः।
en: When at last the animals of the Pandavas were very much tired, the latter proceeded to their camp and took rest there along with their soldiers.

sa: राज्ञो नियोगाद् योद्धव्यं ब्राह्मणेन विशेषतः। वर्तता क्षत्रधर्मेण ह्येवं धर्मविदो विदुः॥
en: At the command of the king, even the Brahmana may fight, especially one who leads the life of Kshatriya. Those learned in the scriptures say this.'

sa: स विगाढां निशां दृष्ट्वा सुप्ते चाण्डालपक्कणे। शनैरुत्थाय भगवान् प्रविवेश कुटीमठम्॥
en: Seeing sometime after that the night had advanced and that the whole Chandala hamlet were in sleep, the holy Vishvamitra, quietly rising up, entered that hut.

sa: एवं धर्मं प्रयत्नेन कौन्तेय परिपालय। ततः पुण्यफलं लब्ध्वा नाधिबधेन योक्ष्यसे॥ स्वर्गलोके सुमहतीं श्रियं प्राप्स्यसि पाण्डव।
en: Do you, O son of Kunti, follow with great care this duty (of protection). You will then obtain the reward of righteousness and suffer no grief and pain. You shall,, O son of Pandu, obtain great prosperity in heaven.

sa: तं तथैव हरिष्यामि न्यस्तधर्माणमद्य वै। पुत्रं पाञ्चालराजस्य पापं पापेन कर्मणा॥
en: I shall kill that slayer to-day under similar circumstances. I shall to-day slay the sinful son of the king of the Panchalas by a sinful act.

sa: अयजनिह सत्रैस्ते तैस्तैः कामैः समाहिताः। संसृष्टा ब्राह्मणैरेव त्रिषु वर्णेषु सृष्टयः॥
en: They adore the gods in sacrifices, for obtaining the fruits of various wishes. The members of the three other orders have all originated from the Brahmanas.

sa: स तस्योरुमथासाद्य बिभेद रुधिराशनः। न चैनमशकत् क्षेप्तुं हन्तुं वापि गुरोर्भयात्॥
en: Getting at Karna's thigh, that blooddrinking worm began to pierce it. Lest his preceptor might get up, Karna could neither throw away nor kill that animal.

sa: ततः प्रतप्ता सा राजन् वाग्यता विगतकमा॥ तत्परा शुचिसंवीता पावके समधिश्रयत्।
en: The damsel, O king, having purified himself, began her task; restraining speech and with fixed attention, she sat to her task, without experiencing the least fatigue.

sa: युवा वृन्दारकः शूरो विकर्णः पुरुषर्षभ। सुखोषितः सुखार्हश्च शेते पांसुषु माधव॥
en: The youthful, brave and beautiful Vikarna, O foremost of men, reared in luxury and worthy of every king of happiness, now sleeps on dust, O Madhava.

sa: एषा ते राष्ट्रवृत्तिश्च राज्ञां गुप्तिश्च भारत। एतमेवार्थमाश्रित्य भूयो वक्ष्यामि पाण्डव॥
en: These, O Bharata, are the instruments of governing a kingdom and protecting its king. I shall again talk to you on the subject, son of Pandu."

sa: तत्रै रुषिता विप्रा विप्रकारप्रधर्षिताः। धक्ष्यन्ति वाग्बला: पापं ततो नाशं गमिष्यति॥
en: Pained by the wrong he will inflict upon them, the Brahmanas, whose power is in speech, will in anger censure him, at which he will die.

sa: ततः शल्यो महाराज कृत्वा कदनमाहवे। ससैन्योऽथ स मध्याह्ने धर्मराजेन घातितः॥
en: Then, O king, having made a great onslaught in battle, Shalya, having lost a large number of his of his force, killed by Yudhishthira at mid-day.

sa: त्वं हि शक्तो रणे जेतुं पञ्चालान् वरूथिनीम्। दैत्यसेनामिव क्रुद्धः सर्वदानवसूदनः॥
en: You are quite competent to defeat the army of the Panchalas in battle, like the destroyer of the Danavas in defeating in anger the Danavas army.

sa: अनुरक्तेन चेष्टेन हृष्टेन जगतीपतिः। अल्पेनापि हि सैन्येन महीं जयति भूमिपः॥
en: A king can conquer the whole Earth with the help of even a small army if that army be loyal, contented, and devoted to his well-being.

sa: तथासौ वाक्प्रतोदेन तुद्यमानः पुनः पुनः। वचो न ममृषे राजन्नुत्तमाश्वः कशामिव॥
en: Struck repeatedly with such wordy goads, he could not bear at all like a horse of high breed that cannot bear the strokes of a whip.

sa: ततः सर्वानुपादाय तनयान् वै महातपाः। रुषङ्गुरब्रवीत् तत्र नयध्वं मां पृथूदकम्॥
en: A great ascetic as he was, he then summoned all his sons and asked them to take him to a spot where there was profuse water.

sa: अक्षौहिणीर्महाबाहुर्दश चैकां च केशव। आनयद् यः पुरा संख्ये सोऽनयान्निधनं गतः॥
en: That mighty-armed one who had in battle collected together eleven Akshauhinis of soldiers, O Keshava, has on account of his own evil policy, been now killed.

sa: बुद्ध्यात्वमुशना साक्षाद् बलेनाधिकृता वयम्। त्वं मन्त्रबलयुक्तो हि दत्त्वा जीवितमद्य मे॥
en: In intelligence you are like Ushanas himself. By the power of your understanding you have conquered us. Clever in policy, you have given us our life.

sa: साधु क्षमा दमः शौचं वैराग्यं चाप्यमत्सरः। अहिंसा सत्यवचनं नित्यानि वनचारिणाम्॥
en: Blessed are forgiveness, and self-control, and purity, with renunciation and humility and abstention from injury, and truthfulness which are all practised by hermits dwelling in forests.

sa: वयं त्विह विना भूता गुणवद्भिर्महारथैः। कृपणं वर्तयिष्याम पातयिता नृपान् बहून्।१४।।
en: As regards ourselves, deprived of those great car-warriors of numerous accomplishments, we shall have to pass our time in sorrow, having caused many kings to die.

sa: दापयित्वा कर धऱ्या राष्ट्र नीत्या यथाविधि। तथैतं कल्पयेद् राजा योगक्षेममतन्द्रितः॥
en: Realising these just taxes and governing the kingdom properly, the king should carefully act in such a way that his subjects may not suffer from want.

sa: अवहासं तु तं मत्वा पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव। उद्धृत्य नयने क्रुद्धो दिधक्षुरिव पाण्डवान्॥ त्रिशिखां भृकुटीं कृत्वा संदष्टदशनच्छदः। प्रत्युवाच ततस्तान् वै पाण्डवान् सहकेशवान्॥
en: Your son Duryodhana considered that action of the onlookers to be an insult to nim. Rolling his eyes in anger and as if consuming the Pandavas with his looks and contracting his brow into three furrows and repeatedly biting his nether lip, he addressed the Pandavas with Keshava in their midst, saying-

sa: ये वैरिणः श्रद्दधते सत्ये सत्येतरेऽपि वा। वध्यन्ते श्रद्दधानास्तु मधु शुष्कतृणैर्यथा॥
en: He, who trust the words, true or false, of an enemy, meets with destruction like a seeker of honey, in a pit covered with dry grass.

sa: कोष्ठागारं च ते नित्यं ज्ञफीतैर्धान्यैःसुसंवृतम्। सदास्तु सत्सु संन्यस्तं धनधान्यपरो भव॥
en: Let your barns, O king, be filled with corn. And let them be entrusted to honest servants. Do your try to increase your wealth and corn.

sa: उपमामत्र वक्ष्यामि धर्मतत्त्वप्रकाशिनीम्। यूपं छिन्दन्ति यज्ञार्थं तत्र ये परिपन्थिनः॥ दुमाः केचन सामन्ता ध्रुवं छिन्दन्ति तानपि। ते चापि निपतन्तोऽन्यान् निघ्नन्त्येव वनस्पतीन्॥
en: I shall here quote an example illustrating the true way of morality. A large tree is cut down for making out of it a sacrificial stake. In cutting it, other trees which stand in its way have also to be cut down. These, also, while falling down, kill others standing there about.

sa: राज्यं तिष्ठति दक्षस्य संगृहीतेन्द्रियस्य च। आर्तस्य बुद्धिमूलं हि विजयं मनुरब्रवीत्॥
en: If the king cleverly does his business and controls his senses, his kingdom lasts. Manu himself has declared that an ambitious person succeeds in gaining victories.

sa: कालोपहतचित्ता हि सर्वे मुह्यन्ति भारत॥ यथा मूढो भवान् पूर्वमस्मिन्नर्थे समुद्यते।
en: Every one, it seems, loses sense under the influence of Destiny, O Bharata, since even you, O king, as regards this matter, did act so foolishly.

sa: तं रथं यादवश्रेष्ठः समारुह्य परंतपः॥ जगाम हास्तिनपुरं त्वरितः केशवो विभुः।
en: That destroyer of foes and chief of Yadu's race, viz., the Lord Keshava, having got upon the car, proceeded speedily to the city of the Kurus.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच शृणु मातृगणान् राजन् कुमारानुचरानिमान्। कीर्त्यमानान् मया वीरं सपत्नगणसूदनान्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Listen now to the numbers of the mothers, those destroyers of foes, O hero that became the companions of Kumara, as I name them.

sa: वशे बलवतां धर्मः सुखं भोगवतामिव। नास्त्यसाध्यं बलवतां सर्वं बलवतां शुचि॥
en: Righteousness depends on the powerful does as pleasure on the pleasure hunters. There is nothing which powerful men cannot do. Everything is pure with the powerful.

sa: नि:सज्ञं पतितं भूमौ तदासीद् राजमण्डलम्॥ प्रलापयुक्तं महति चित्रन्यस्तं पटे यथा।
en: All those royal persons remained lying on the ground, deprived of their consciousness and crying in delirium, like figures painted on a large piece of canvas.

sa: बभूव दुर्मना राजंश्चिन्तयामास च प्रभुः।
en: Seeing his kingdom thus afflicted the power king became very depressed and anxious.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच शरतल्पगते भीष्मे कौरवाणां धुरन्धरे। आजग्मुर्ऋषयः सिद्धा नारदप्रमुखा नृप॥
en: Vaishampayana said When Bhishma, that chief of the Kurus, lay on his bed of arrows, many Rishis and Siddhas, O king, headed by Narada, came there.

sa: कृषिगोरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं लोकानामिह जीवनम्। ऊर्ध्वं चैव त्रयी विद्या सा भूतान् भावयत्युत।॥
en: Agriculture, cattle-tending, and trade, suppiy all men with the means of subsistence. A knowledge of the Vedas, however, supply them with the means of acquiring heaven.

sa: पक्वसस्या हि पृथिवी भवत्यम्बुमती तदा। नैवातिशीतो नात्युष्ण: कालो भवति भारत॥
en: The crops ripen about that time and water also is not scarce. That time of the year, O Bharata, is neither very cold nor very hot.

sa: ते तु क्रुद्धा महाराज पाण्डवस्य महारथम्॥ निग्रहीतुं प्रवृत्ता हि योधांश्चान्यानवारयन्।
en: His antagonists meanwhile, filled with rage, O monarch, tried to assail that great car-warrior of the Pandavas and opposed other combatants (that tried to rescue him).

sa: तपसाधिगतं चान्नं प्रजार्थं मे पितामह। ओषध्यः परिवर्तेरन् यथैवं सततं प्रजाः॥
en: I have, by my active penances, O Grandfather, created all these creatures. These herbs and plants also will multiply like those that will live upon them.

sa: धिगस्तु खलु मानुष्यं मानुषेषु परिग्रहे। यतो मूलानि दुःखानि सम्भवन्ति मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: He said:-'Fie on the humanity. Fie out the human body. The miseries that we suffer in this life frequently originate from the very state of humanity.

sa: यदा पश्यामि चाण्डालमायान्तं शस्त्रपाणिनम्। ततश्छेत्स्यामि ते पाशान् प्राप्ते साधारणे भये॥
en: When I shall see the hunter come here armed with weapons, I shall cut the strings at that very moment of fear to both of us.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच प्रमुक्तं द्रोणकर्णाभ्यां ब्रह्मास्त्रमरिमर्दन॥ कस्त्वदन्यः सहेत् साक्षादपि वज्री पुरंदरः।
en: Yudhishthira said Who else, except you. O destroyer of foes, not even thunder-holding Purandara himself, could have withstood the Brahma weapons discharged by Drona and Karna!

sa: ततः सविशिखं चापं सहदेवस्य धन्विनः। छित्त्वा भल्लेन समरे विव्याधैनं त्रिसप्तभिः॥
en: Then cutting off with a broad-headed arrow the bow, with shaft fixed on the string, of Sahadeva, he struck Sahadeva himself in that battle, with seventy-arrows.

sa: त्वं चाश्वसिहि कौन्तेय ये चाप्यनुगतास्तव। अहमुत्थाय वः सर्वान् प्रतियोत्स्यामि संयुगे॥
en: Do you, O son of Kunti, take a little rest with your followers. Rising from this lake I will surely fight all of you in battle.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच सभासदः सहायाश्च सुहृदश्च विशाम्पते। परिच्छदास्तथामात्याः कीदृशाः स्युः पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said What should be the gratification, O grandfather, of the law-makers, the ministers of war, the countries, the commanders, and the counsellors of a king!

sa: प्रीत्या ददौ स कर्णाय मालिनी नगरीमथ। अड्रेषु नरशार्दूल स राजाऽऽसीत् सपत्नजित्॥ पालयामास चम्पां च कर्णः परबलार्दनः। दुर्योधनस्यानुमते तवापि विदितं तथा॥
en: Out of friendship he then gave to Karna the town Malini. Before this, that foremost of men and subjugator of all enemies (Karna), had been king of the Angas only, but from that time that grinder of hostile forces, began to rule over Champa also, as desired by Duryodhana, as you know.

sa: न कोशः शुद्धशौचेन न नृशंसेन जातुचित्। मध्यमं पदमास्थाय कोशसंग्रहणं चरेत्॥
en: The treasury cannot be replenished by (acting with) purity and fairness, nor by (acting with) ruthless cruelty. It should be filled by following a middle course.

sa: शरैराशीविषाकारैर्ध्वलज्वलनसंनिभैः। सारथिं चास्य समरे शरेणानतपर्वणा॥ विव्याध भृशसंक्रुद्धस्तं वै भूयस्त्रिभिः शरैः।
en: Worked up with great ire, he then struck his antagonist's driver with a straight shaft in that battle and then Shałya himself once more with three.

sa: स तु तान् सर्वतो यत्ताशरैः संछाद्य मारिप॥ धर्मराजमवच्छाद्य सिंहवद् व्यनदन्मुहुः।
en: Assailing vigorously all the Pandava heroes with his with his arrows from every side, O sire, Shalya covered king Yudhishthira and roared repeatedly like a lion.

sa: यथा शत्रून् घातयित्वा पुरुषः कुरुनन्दन। आत्मानं घातयेत् पश्चात् कर्मेदं नस्तथोपमम्॥
en: Or, it is like that of a person who having killed all his enemies, O you of Kuru's race, at last dies at his own hand.

sa: किंस्वित् सत्यं किमनृतं किंस्विद् धर्म्य सनातनम्। कस्मिन्काले वदेत्सत्यं कस्मिन्कालेऽनृतं वदेत्॥
en: What again is truth? What is falsehood? What, again, is eternal virtue? When should a person tell the truth, and when should he tell an untruth?

sa: ततः शल्यो रणे राजन् सर्वास्तान् दशभिः शरैः। विव्याध भृशसंक्रुद्धस्तोत्रैरिव महाद्विपान्॥
en: At this, Shalya, O king, worked up with rage, deeply struck all of them with ten arrows, like persons piercing mighty elephants with sharp pointed lances.

sa: प्रदानकाक्षिणीनां च कन्यानां वयसि स्थिते। श्रुत्वा कथास्तथायुक्ताः साऽऽशा कृशतरी मया॥
en: The hope of marriage in grown up maidens when they hear any body only talk of it in their presence, is slenderer than even my body.

sa: अर्जुनेति जनः कश्चित् कश्चित् कर्णेति भारत। कश्चिद् दुर्योधनेत्येवं ब्रुवन्तः प्रस्थितास्तदा॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, some of them named Arjuna), some Karna and some Duryodhana (as the victor of the day) as they went away.

sa: तथेत्युक्त्वा तु ते सर्वे रथेस्तूर्णं प्रहारिणः। आचार्यधनदानार्थं द्रोणेन सहिता ययुः॥
en: Saying “Be it so," they all ascended their chariots with their arms and marched out with Drona in order to pay the remuneration to their preceptor.

sa: स मत्स्यो नाम राजासीद्धार्मिकः सत्यसंगरः। साप्सरा मुक्तशापा च क्षणेन समपद्यत॥
en: That child became afterwards the virtuous and powerful monarch, named Matsya. The Apsara was also released from her form as soon as the children were born,

sa: वासुकिरुवाच आस्तीक परिघूर्णामि हृदयं मे विदीर्यते। दिशो न प्रतिजानामि ब्रह्मदण्डनिपीडितः॥
en: Vasuki said: O Astika, being afflicted with my mother's curse my head is whirling, my heart is breaking. I cannot see the points of the heavens.

sa: अपवादः स किल ते पुनरेष्यति राघव॥ यदर्थं मैथिली त्यक्ता अपवादभयानृप। सोऽपवादः पुरे राजन्भविष्यति न संशयः॥
en: O Rāghava, you shall again be blamed by the people. In fear of this calumny, O king, that you have renounced Maithili. And if do you grieve for that spouse your calumny shall undoubtedly be deep-routed in the kingdom.

sa: प्रमतिरुवाच ततः पितामहाज्ञातः सर्वं चक्रे तदाऽरुणः। उदितश्चैव सविता ह्यरुणेन समावृतः॥
en: Sauti said : away all his Thereupon Aruna, ordered by the Grandsire, did all that he was commanded to do. The sun rose covered by Aruna.

sa: सोमस्याहं सुदयितः सुतः सुरुचिरानने। भजस्व मां वरारोहे भक्त्या स्निग्धेन चक्षुषा॥
en: O you of a graceful presence, I am the most favourite son of the moon; O fair one, do you, with delight, cast looks upon me.

sa: ज्ञात्वा तथापनीतां तां वसुभिर्दिव्यदर्शनः। ययौ क्रोधवशं सद्यः शशाप च वसूंस्तदा॥
en: The man of ascetic vision then found that she had been stolen by the Vasus. His anger was at once roused and he cursed the Vasus-

sa: ऋषेः पुत्रो महातेजा बालोऽपि स्थविरद्युतिः॥ स क्षिप्रमुदकं स्पृष्ट्वा रोषादिदमुवाच ह।
en: Though that son of the Rishi was but a boy, he had the splendour of mature age. He speedily touched water and spoke thus in anger,

sa: देवराजं तदा यान्तं सह देवैरवेक्ष्य तु॥ वासुदेवार्जुनौ वीरौ सिंहनादं विनेदतुः।
en: When those two heroes, Vasudeva and Arjuna, saw the chief of the celestial retreat with all the dwellers of heaven, they set up a leonine roar.

sa: श्रूयते हि पुराणेऽपि जटिला नाम गौतमी। ऋषीनध्यासितवती सप्त धर्मभृतां वरा॥
en: I have heard in the Puranas that a lady of the Gautama race named Jatila, the foremost of all virtuous women, married seven Rishis (all together.)

sa: लब्ध्वा वराणि दैत्येन्द्रावथ तौ भ्रातरावुभौ। अवध्यौ सर्वलोकस्य स्वमेव भवनं गतौ॥
en: Having received those boons, those two brothers, the chiefs of Danavas, became nonslayable by any creature in the universe. They then returned to their own home.

sa: समासो भारतस्यायमत्रोक्तः पर्वसंग्रहः। पौष्यं पौलोममास्तीकमादिरंशावतारणम्॥
en: Of which the above is an abridgement. Adi-Parva contains, Paushya, Pauloma, Astika, Adi-anshavatarana,

sa: दिशां गजं तु श्वेतारव्यं श्वेताजनयदाशुगम्। तथा दुहितरौ राजन् सुरभिर्वै व्यजायत॥
en: And Shveta gave birth to the large elephant, known by the name of Shveta which possesses great speed. O king, Surabhi gave birth to two daughters,

sa: प्रमाणदृष्टो धर्मोऽयं पूज्यते च महर्षिभिः। उत्तरेषु च रम्भोरु कुरुष्वद्यापि पूज्यते॥
en: O lady of tapering thighs, the practice, being sanctioned by presidents, is praised by great Rishis; it is still regarded with respect by the Northern Kurus.

sa: गान्धारी च महाभागा कुन्ती च जयतां वर। स्त्रियश्च राज्ञः सर्वास्ताः सप्रेष्याः सपिरच्छदाः॥ हर्षादारुरुहुर्मञ्चान् मेरुं देवस्त्रियो यथा। ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियाद्यं च चातुर्वण्र्यं पुराद् द्रुतम्॥ दर्शनेप्सु समभ्यागात् कुमाराणां कृतास्त्रताम्। क्षणेनैकस्थतां तत्र दर्शनेप्सु जगाम ह॥
en: The great fortunate Gandhari and Kunti and the other ladies of the royal household, dressed in gorgeous attire and accompanied by their maids in waiting, joyfully ascended the platforms as celestial ladies ascended the Sumeru mountain. Brahmanas, Kshatriyas and the others of the four orders of caste hurriedly left the city and came running there with the desire of seeing the princes skill in arms and they were so anger that they assembled all there in a moment.

sa: हत्वा शालावृकेभ्यश्च प्रायच्छल्लवशः कृतम्। ततो गावो निवृत्तास्ता अगोपा: स्वं निवेशनम्॥
en: They hacked him to pieces and gave his body to be devoured by jackals and wolves. The kine returned to the fold without the cowherd (Kacha).

sa: तथा बलवता भीमः पाणिभ्यां भृशमाहतः। नैवावलोकयामास राक्षसं भुङ्क्त एव सः॥
en: Though Bhima was struck in great force with the arms (of the Rakshasas), yet he did not even look at him, but he continued to eat.

sa: कुलीना रूपवत्यश्च ताः कन्याः पुत्र सर्वशः। उचिताश्चैव सम्बन्धे तेऽस्माकं क्षत्रियर्षभाः॥
en: O sons, all these maidens are the best of Kshatriyas; they are beautiful and of are birth; they are eminently fit for alliance with our family.

sa: पारिक्षितकथां दिव्यां पुण्याय विजयाय च। कथ्यमानां मया कृत्स्नां शृणु हर्षकरीमिमाम्॥
en: O son of Parikshit, this pleasant and sacred history that secures victory, (to the hearer), I shall now recite to you in full, Listen to it.

sa: स तानग्रभुजस्तात धान्येन च धनेन च॥ सोमान्ते तर्पयामास विपुलेन विशाम्पतिः।
en: O child, after performing the Soma sacrifice, the king gratified the revivers of the first portions of Yagna (Brahmanas) with large presents of rice and wealth.

sa: कथं त्वशक्ता त्राणाय माता तेषां तपस्विनी। भविष्यति हि शोकार्ता पुत्रत्राणमपश्यती॥
en: How shall their ascetic mother be able to save them? She will be afflicted with great sorrow when she will find herself unable to save them.

sa: सौतिरुवाच वासुकिस्त्वब्रवीद्वाक्यं जरत्कारुमृषि तदा। सनाम्नी तव कन्येयं स्वसा मे तपसान्विता॥
en: Sauti said : Thereupon Vasuki said to the Rishi Jaratkaru, “This maiden has the same name as yours. She is my sister and is an ascetic.

sa: विपरीतं मया चेदं त्रयं सर्वमुपार्जितम्। तदिमामापदं प्राप्य भृशं तप्यामहे वयम्॥
en: In the matter of the acquisition of these three, my course has been (quite) the reserve. Therefore falling into this danger, I am suffering great affections.

sa: अथवा यास्यसे तत्र त्यक्त्वा मां द्विजसत्तम्। पीडिताहं भविष्यामि तदवेक्षस्व मामपि॥
en: O best of the twice-born, leaving me behind, if you go there (to the Rakshasas) I shall be very much pained; therefore be kind to ine.

sa: अनाथा कृपणा बाला यत्रक्वचनगामिनी। भविष्यामि त्वया तात विहीना कृपणा सदा॥
en: O father, I am but a girl being abandoned by you, I shall be helpless and miserable and I shall have to go anywhere and everywhere.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच ऋतेऽमरत्वं युवयोः सर्वमुक्तं भविष्यति। अन्यद् वृणीतं मृत्योश्च विधानममरैः समम्॥
en: Brahma said: Except being immortal, you two will be all that you desire. Ask for some death by which you may be equal to the immortals.

sa: वासुदेवोऽपि जग्राह प्रीतिं पार्थेन शाश्वतीम्। ददौ सुरपतिश्चैव वरं कृष्णाय धीमते॥
en: Vasudeva (Krishna) asked that his friendship with Arjuna might last forever. The chief of the celestial (Indra) granted to the intelligent Krishna the boon he asked.

sa: ते चे पञ्च शतं चैव कुरुवंशविवर्धनाः। सर्वे ववृधुरल्पेन कालेनाप्स्विव नीरजाः॥
en: These five (Pandavas) and the hundred (sons of Dhritarashtra), the extenders of the Kuru race, grew up rapidly like an assembly of lotuses in a lake.

sa: सौतिरुवाच तथेत्युक्त्वा ततः सर्वे काद्रवेयाः समागताः। समयं चक्रिरे तत्र मन्त्रबुद्धिविशारदाः॥
en: Sauti said: Thus addressed, all the offspring of Kadru assembled together; they were all wise in counsel and they gave their opinions (one after the other.)

sa: ततोऽक्षैर्वञ्चयित्वा च सौबलेन युधिष्ठिरम्। वनं प्रस्थापयामास सप्त वर्षाणि पञ्च च॥
en: Thereupon he deceived Yudhishthira by means of a game, played by the son of Subala (Shakuni) and he sent him to the forest for twelve years.

sa: मयि तिष्ठति दुष्टात्मन् न स्त्रियं हन्तुमर्हसि। संगच्छस्व मया सार्धमेकेनैको नराशन॥
en: O wicked wretch, you should not kill a woman when I am here. O cannibal, come with me (to a distance) and fight singly with me.

sa: तान् धौम्यः प्रतिजग्राह सर्ववेदविदां वरः। वन्येन फलमूलेन पौरोहित्येन चैव ह॥
en: Dhaumya, the foremost of all men learned in the Vedas, received them with the offerings of wild fruits and roots and consented to be their priest.

sa: एषोऽस्माकं कुलस्तम्ब आस्ते स्वकुलवर्धनः। यानि पश्यसि वै ब्रह्मन्मूलानीहास्य वीरुधः॥ एते नस्तन्तवस्तात कालेन परिभक्षिताः। यत्त्वेतत्पश्यसि ब्रह्मन्मूलमस्याधभक्षितम्॥
en: Is the cord representing our race. O Brahmana, these threads of the Virana roots which you see eaten up (by the rat) are we ourselves, who have been eaten up by Time. This root which you see half eaten,

sa: पुनरस्मानुपादाय तथैव व्रज भारत। त्वं हि नो बलवानेको यथा सततगस्तथा॥
en: "O descendant of Bharata, take us on you again and proceed as before. You alone amongst us are strong and (you are) as swift as wind."

sa: एलापत्र उवाच एवमस्विति तं देवाः पितामहमथाब्रुवन्। उक्त्वैवं वचनं देवान्विरिञ्चिस्त्रिदिवं ययौ॥
en: Elapatra said : The celestials said to the Grandsire, "Be it so," and the lord Brahma, having said all this to the celestial went to heaven.

sa: अद्यप्रभृति मे दाश ब्रह्मचर्यं भविष्यति। अपुत्रस्यापि मे लोका भविष्यन्त्यक्षया दिवि॥
en: O fisherman, from this day I adopt the vow of Brahmacharya. If I die sonless, still I shall ascend to the rejoins of the everlasting bliss.

sa: अथ दानापदेशेन कुन्ती ब्राह्मणभोजनम्। चक्रे निशि महाराज आजग्मुस्तत्र योषितः॥ ता विहृत्य यथाकामं भुक्त्वा पीत्वा च भारत। जग्मुर्निशि गृहानेव समनुज्ञाप्य माधवीम्॥
en: On the occasion of an alms giving, Kunti fed on a certain night a large number of Brahmanas. There came also a number of ladies. O descendant of Bharata, they ate and drank and enjoyed themselves as much as they pleased. And they all returned home with the permissions of Madhvi (Kunti).

sa: वयं तु यदि दाहस्य बिभ्यतः प्रद्रवेमहि। स्पशैर्निर्घातयेत् सर्वान् राज्यलुब्धः सुयोधनः॥
en: If we fly from this place from the fear of being brunt, Duryodhana, covetous for kingdom, will surely bring about our death by means of spies.

sa: ययातिरुवाच नाहं देवमनुष्येषु गन्धर्वेषु महर्षिषु। आत्मनस्तपसा तुल्यं कंचित् पश्यामि वासव॥
en: Yayati said: O Vasava (Indra), I do not find among men, the celestials, the Gandharvas and great Rishis, any one equal to me in ascetic merits.

sa: इन्द्र उवाच श्च्युतः प्रतिष्ठां यत्र लब्धासि भूयः। एतद् विदित्वा च पुनर्ययाते त्वं मावमंस्थाः सदृशः श्रेयसश्च॥
en: Indra said: O king, you shall fall among those that are virtuous and honest. You shall also gain great renown. O Yayati, after your this experience, never again disregard any one, your superiors, your equals or even your inferiors.

sa: शृंगिस्तव पिता सोऽपि तथैवास्ते यतव्रतः। सोऽपि राजा स्वनगरं प्रस्थितो गजसाह्वयम्॥
en: O Shringi, your father, engaged in devotion, is still in that posture. The king has, however, gone away to his capital (Hastinapur), named after the elephant.

sa: पततां चैव नागानां घिष्ठितानां तथाम्बरे। अश्रूयतानिशं शब्दः पच्यतां चाग्निना भृशम्॥
en: Incessant were the piteous cries of the snakes that fell into the fire and of those that were in the air about to fall into it.

sa: अमानुषैर्वृतः सत्त्वैर्मानुषः सन् महायशाः। विप्रैः स विग्रहं चक्रे वीर्योन्मत्तः पुरूरवाः॥ जहार च स विप्राणां रत्नान्युत्क्रोशतामपि।
en: Though he was a human being, yet he remained always surrounded by superhuman companions. Pururava, intoxicated with the pride of power which he possessed, quarrelled with the Brahmanas, caring little for their anger. He robbed them of their wealth.

sa: स एवमुक्तो नागेन काश्यपो द्विपदां वरः। लब्ध्वा वित्तं निववृते तक्षकाद्यावदीप्सितम्॥
en: The best of men, Kashyapa, being thus addressed by the snake and having received from him as much wealth as he desired to get, went back.

sa: संमन्त्र्य मन्त्रिभिश्चैव स तथा मन्त्रतत्त्ववित्। प्रासादं कारयामास एकं स्तम्भं सुरक्षितम्॥
en: Having consulted with his ministers, the king himself, wise in counsels, caused a palace to be erected on a pillar, guarded day and night by men.

sa: यदि वीर समग्रा ते मेदिनी निखिला वशे। देवराज्यं कुरुष्वेह सभृत्यबलवाहनः॥
en: If the whole world is under your subjection, O hero, be you, with the whole host of your servants and soldiers, installed on the celestial throne.

sa: तदा तस्य प्रहृष्टस्य शत्रुघ्नस्य महात्मनः। व्यतीता वार्षिकी रात्रिः श्रावणी लघुविक्रमा॥
en: "Blessed it is that Sītā has given birth to two sons.” And with this joy the live long night of Śrāvaņa passed away in no time.

sa: यज्ञाश्च दक्षिणाश्चैवं ग्रहास्ताराश्च भारत। यज्ञवाहश्च ये मन्त्राः सर्वे तत्र समासते॥
en: The sacrificial Dakshinas (gifts to Brahmanas), the planets, the starts, the Mantras which are uttered in sacrifices, O descendant of Bharata, all these are present there.

sa: अयोध्यायां पुरा राजा युवनाश्वसुतो बली। मांधाता इति विख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु वीर्यवान्॥
en: The early king of Ayodhyā was known over the three worlds under the name of Māndhātā. He was the son of Yuvanāśva, highly powerful and strong.

sa: नारदः पर्वतश्चैव मम दत्त्वा महद्भयम्। गतौ त्रिभुवनं भद्रौ वायुभूतावनिन्दितौ ॥
en: Having imprecated a dreadful curse upon me the jolly saint Nārada and the ascetic Parvata have speedily, like the wind, repaired to the region of Brahmă.

sa: न शक्योऽसौ रणे जेतुं सर्वैरपि सुरासुरैः। बाहुयुद्धेन जेतव्यः स इत्युपलभामहे॥
en: He is incapable of being vanquished in battle by all the celestials and the Asuras. Therefore, my opinion is to defeat him in a single combat.

sa: तथा पात्रविशेषाश्च दानानां च परो विधिः। आचारविधियोगश्च सत्यस्य च परागतिः॥
en: The different merits of charity according to the subjects of charity; the rules of living, the ceremonials of individual duty and the matchless merits of truth.

sa: अस्य काव्यस्य कवयो न समर्था विशेषणे। विशेषणे गृहस्थस्य शेषास्त्रय इवाश्रमाः॥
en: There will be no poets in this world whose works will equal this poem, as the three other Ashramas are never equal to the domestic Ashrama.

sa: यथा च जन्मप्रभृति यतात्माऽहं धृतव्रतः। प्रमद्वरा तथा ह्येषा समुत्तिष्ठतु भामिनी॥
en: If ever I have controlled my passions from my birth, if ever I have stuck to my vows, let the beautiful Pramadvara rise from the ground.”

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच आगतानेकचक्रायाः सोदर्यानेकचारिणः। भवन्तो वै विजानन्तु सह मात्रा द्विजर्षभाः॥
en: Yudhishthira said : O best of the twice born, know, Sirs, that we are five brothers travelling with our mother. We are now coming from Ekachakra.

sa: तस्मै यथावत् सत्कारं कृत्वा तेन च सत्कृताः। कथान्ते चाभ्यनुज्ञाताः प्रययुर्दुपदक्षयम्॥
en: Duly worshipping the Rishi and being saluted by him, when their conversation came to a close, they proceeded by his command to the palace of Drupada.

sa: मयि नीतिर्बलं भीमे रक्षिता चावयोर्जयः। मागधं साधयिष्याम इष्टिं त्रय इवाग्नयः॥
en: In me is policy, and in Bhima is strength, and we are both protected by Arjuna. We shall vanquish the Magadha king like three (sacrifice) fires.

sa: क्रीडन्तीनां त कन्यानां वने चैत्ररथोपमे। वायुभूत: स वस्त्राणि सर्वाण्येव व्यमिश्रयत्॥
en: The maidens were sporting in a lake in the wood which was like that of Chitraratha. Changing himself into wind, he (Indra) mixed up their clothes.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तेषां श्रुत्वा महाबाहुर्वार्यमाणस्तपोधनैः। जगाम तानि तीर्थानि द्रष्टुं पुरुषसत्तमः॥
en: Vaishampayana said: Having heard these words of the ascetics, the mighty armed hero, that best of men, though dissuaded by them, went to see those Tirthas.

sa: ततः समाजो ववृधे स राजन् दिवसान् बहून्। रत्नप्रदानबहुलः शोभितो नटनर्तकैः॥
en: O king, that assemblage daily increased in bulk,) and it looked gay with (the performances of) actors and dancers. Large presents of wealth were also made.

sa: विश्रान्तास्ते महात्मान: कंचित् कालं महाबलाः। आहूता धृतराष्ट्रेण राज्ञा शांतनवेन च॥
en: When those illustrious and greatly strong heroes had taken rest for some time, they were summoned by the king Dhritarashtra and the son of Shantanu (Bhishma.)

sa: तत्र चोत्पत्स्यते जन्तुर्भवतां तारणाय वै। शाश्वतं स्थानमासाद्य मोदन्तां पितरो मम॥
en: O fathers, I shall beget offspring on her for your release, so that you may attain to the heaven, called Shashvata and rejoice there at will.

sa: आद्यं पशुपतेः स्थानं दर्शनादेव मुक्तिदम्। यत्र पापोऽपि मनुजः प्राप्नोत्यभयदं पदम्॥
en: This pilgrimage is the first place of lord Shiva and gives salvation only by seeing it and, where even a sinful man gets fearless place son

sa: मधुरं कथ्यते सौम्य श्लक्ष्णाक्षरपदं त्वया। प्रीयामहे भृशं तात पितेवेदं प्रभाषसे॥
en: O gentle one, you speak very sweetly with proper accent and emphasis. We are very much, pleased with your speech. You speak like your (late) father.

sa: दृष्ट्वा तत्र राजा स शान्तनुः। शङ्कमानः सुतं गङ्गामब्रवीद् दर्शयेति ह॥
en: The king Shantanu, being much surprised with what he saw and believing the youth to be his own son, said to Ganga, "Show me the child."

sa: अहं हि तपती नाम सावित्र्यवरजा सुता। अस्य लोकप्रदीपस्य सवितुः क्षत्रियर्षभ॥
en: My name is Tapati, I am the younger sister of Savitri. O best of Kshatriyas, I am the daughter of Surya, the illuminator of the Universe.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच उक्तवन्तो यथा वीर्यमसकृत् सर्ववृष्ण्यः। ततोऽब्रवीद् वासुदेवो वाक्यं धर्मार्थसंयुतम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : When the powerful Vrishnis all began to speak in this strain, then Vasudeva (Krishna) spoke these words of deep import and true morality.

sa: दातुमैच्छत् ततः कन्यां तस्मै संवरणाय ताम्। नृपोत्तमाय कौरव्य विश्रुताभिजनाय च॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, Surya then desired to bestow his daughter on that excellent king Samvarana of the Kuru race, who celebrated all over the world.

sa: ततो मन्युर्वसिष्ठस्य प्रादुरासीन्महात्मनः। अदर्शनेन राजाहर्तुमुपचक्रमे।॥
en: And not beholding the King the high-souled Vasiştha was greatly angry and said.

sa: यो विद्याच्चतुरो वेदान् साङ्गोपनिषदो द्विजः। न चाख्यानमिदं विद्यान्नैव स स्याद्विचक्षणः॥
en: He who is learned in the four Vedas with all the Angas and Upanishads, but does not know this history, cannot be considered to be wise.

sa: एतत्तदद्भुतं दृष्ट्वा निराशा दानवाः स्थिताः। अमृतार्थे च लक्ष्यर्थे महान्तं वैरमाश्रिताः॥
en: Seeing all those wonderful phenomena, the Danavas were filled with despair. They raised up great hostilities with the celestials for the possession of Lakshmi and Ambrosia.

sa: अवरोप्येह वृक्षं तु फलकाले निपात्यते। निहन्मैनं दुरात्मानं योऽयमस्मान् न मन्यते॥
en: Having planted the tree, he cuts it down when it is about to bear fruits. The wretch does not respect us, therefore let us kill him.

sa: सादर्शनं पुरा सीता लङ्का पारे महोदधेः। ततश्चापि मयानीता किं पुनर्वसुधातलात्॥
en: Formerly, in my absence, Janaki was once carried away into the city her back; what wonder it is that I shall get her back from Pātāla?

sa: स कदाचिद्भवां कोटी: सवत्साः स्वर्णभूषिताः। नृदेवो भूमिदेवेभ्यः पुष्करेषु ददौ नृपः॥
en: Once on a time at the sacred pilgrimage of Puşpaka that king conferred upon the Brāhmaṇas one Koți of kine with calves adorned with golden ornaments.

sa: ताय॑श्चारिष्टनेमिश्च तथैव गरुडारुणौ। आरुणिर्वारुणिश्चैव वैनतेयाः प्रकीर्तिताः। शेषोऽनन्तो वासुकिश्च तक्षकश्च भुजंगमः॥
en: O protector of the world, the Tarkshya, Arishtanemi, Garuda, Arun, Aruni and Varuni were known to be the sons of Vinata. Shesha of Ananta, Vasuki, Takshaka,

sa: ममाप्येषा मतिस्तात या भीष्मस्य महात्मनः। संवभिज्यास्तु कौन्तेया धर्म एष सनातनः॥
en: O Sire, my opinion is as that of the illustrious Bhishma. Let the sons of Kunti have a share in the kingdom. It is eternal virtue.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच ज्येष्ठानुज्येष्ठा तामेषां नामधेयानि वा विभो। धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राणामानुपूर्वेण कीर्तय॥
en: Janamejaya said : O Lord, tell me the names of all the sons of Dhritarashtra beginning from the eldest, according to the order of their births.

sa: तामथ प्रत्युवाचेदमीशानो वदतां वरः। पञ्च ते पतयो भद्रे भविष्यन्तीति भारताः॥
en: Then tnat foremost of all great speakers, Ishana (Shiva,) replied to her saying, “O blessed lady, you will have five husbands from among the Bharata princes."

sa: ते वयं प्राप्तकालस्य चिकीर्षा मन्त्रयामहे। यथा नो न गसेयुस्ते सपुत्रवलबान्धवान्॥
en: The time has come when we should consult together, so that they (the Pandavas) may not swallow us all with our sons, forces, friends and relatives.

sa: अन्यस्मिन् नृप कर्तव्ये त्वमन्यत् कुरुषेऽनघ। तेषां बलविधातो हि कर्तव्यस्तात नित्यशः॥
en: O sinless one, you are not acting as you should. You ought to act every day in a way as to weaken their (the Pandavas') strength.

sa: आख्याहि मे को भवानुग्ररूपो नमोऽस्तु ते देववर प्रसीद। विज्ञातुमिच्छामि भवन्तमाद्यं न हि प्रजानामि तव प्रवृत्तिम्॥
en: Tell me who are you with this fearful form. I bow down my head to you; be gracious to me, O chief of the gods. I desire to know you, Primeval One; for I do not understand your actions.

sa: यद् रात्रौ कुरुते पापं ब्राह्मणः स्त्रीगणैर्वृतः। महाभारतमाख्याय पूर्व संध्या प्रमुच्यते॥
en: Whatever sins a Brahmana may commit at night in the midst of women, are all washed off before dawn by reciting a portion of the Mahabharata.

sa: षण्णामात्मनि युक्तानामिन्द्रियाणां प्रमाथिनाम्। यो धीरो धारयेद् रश्मीन् स स्यात् परमसारथिः॥
en: That man is an excellent driver who knows how to patiently wield the reins of these and horses, namely the six senses inherent in our nature.

sa: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र ब्रह्मणस्तीर्थमुत्तमम्। तत्र वर्णावरः स्नात्वा ब्राह्मण्यं लभते नरः॥ ब्राह्मणश्च विशुद्धात्मा गच्छेत परमां गतिम्।
en: O king of kings, one should then go to the excellent Tirtha, called Brahma. Bathing there, the other three orders obtain the states of Brahmana. And if a Brahman bathes there, he becomes pure-souled and obtains the highest refuge.

sa: स तथा नगराभ्याशे सत्कारार्हो न सत्कृतः। त्रिरात्रमुषितो राजा जलमात्रेण वर्तयन्॥
en: Thus unregarded, though worthy of their (citizen's) regards, that king stayed three nights outside the precincts of the city living, all the while solely on water.

sa: इहैव वर्तमानास्ते समीपे तव पार्थिव। अजातपक्षाः शिशवः शकिता नैव बाधितुम्॥
en: O. king, they were then living near you, they were then mere children, they were then without allies and friends, still you could nor injure them.

sa: लब्धव्यान्येव लभते गन्तव्यान्येव गच्छति। प्राप्तव्यान्येव चाप्नोति दुःखानि च सुखानि च॥
en: One gets only what has been ordained. One goes whence he was ordained to go. Those sorrows and joys only are obtained that are ordained so.

sa: तथा हि सत्यं ब्रुवति प्रजाहिते नरेन्द्रसूनौ गुरुसौहृदाद् गुहः। मुमोच बाष्पं व्यसनाभिपीडितो ज्वरातुरो नाग इव व्यथातुरः॥
en: When that son of the foremost of men, intent on the welfare of the subjects had spoken thus truly, Guha, out of extreme affection for (Rāma), shed tears afflicted with grief and hurt like an elephant suffering from fever.

sa: सप्तसारस्वतं तीर्थं ततो गच्छेन्नराधिप॥ यत्र मङ्कणकः सिद्धो महर्षिर्लोकविश्रुतः। पुरा मङ्कणको राजन् कुशाचेणेति नः श्रुतम्॥ क्षतः किल करे राजंस्तस्य शाकरसोऽस्रवत्। स वै शाकरसं दृष्ट्वा हर्षाविष्टः प्रनृत्तवान्॥
en: O ruler of men, one should then go to the Tirtha, called Sapta-Sarasvata. Where the celebrated great Rishi Mankanaka obtained success in asticism. O king, we have heard that in the days of yore Mankanaka cut his hand with kusha grass and from his that wound vegetable juice flowed out (instead of blood). O king, seeing that vegetable juice, he began to dance in joy.

sa: अमोघं बत मे क्षान्तं पुरुषे पुष्करेक्षणे। येयमिक्ष्वाकुराजश्रीः पुत्र त्वां संश्रयिष्यति॥
en: Ah! not unfruitful has proved my disinterested observance of vow to the lotus-eyed person, for this royal fortune of the Ikşvāku race shall rest upon you.

sa: वालखिल्या ऊचुः इन्द्रार्थोऽयं समारम्भः सर्वेषां नः प्रजापते। अपत्यार्थं समारम्भो भवतश्चायमीप्सितः॥
en: The Valakhilyas said : O Prajapati, our this action (penance) is for creating an Indra. It is also meant for a son being born to you.

sa: स भवानभ्यनुज्ञातः शुचिकर्मा महाव्रतः। ब्रूहि कामानतोऽन्यांस्त्वं करिष्यामि हि ते वचः॥
en: Purged in sin, you of high vows, consider yourself as pardoned. Tell me now what else do you wish. I shall certainly accomplish those your commands.'

sa: शक्यं वा यदि वाशक्यं करिष्यामि वचस्तव। एवमुक्ता ततः कृष्णमब्रवीद् यदुनन्दनम्॥
en: Whether I am able or not, I shall do what you will say." Having been thus addressed, she thus spoke to the descendant of Yadu, Krishna.

sa: यामेतां पेशीं मम निष्क्रयाय प्रादाद् भवानसिनोत्कृत्य राजन्। एतद् वो लक्ष्म शिवं करोमि हिरण्यवर्णं रुचिरं पुण्यगन्धम्॥
en: O king, these pieces of flesh that you have cut off from your body with your sword to save me, have made gashes in your body. I shall make these marks auspicious. They will be handsome, golden-coloured and sweet-scented.

sa: स गच्छ विनिवर्तस्व कुरुक्षेत्रं रणप्रिय। तत्रैष्यामि महाबाहो युद्धाय त्वांत पोधन॥
en: Being slain by a hundred arrows shot by me, you will obtain those regions earned by your asceticism, being sanctified by my weapons in the battle.

sa: आर्यपुत्र पिता माता भ्राता पुत्रस्तथा स्नुषा। स्वानि पुण्यानि भुञ्जानाः स्वं स्वं भाग्यमुपासते॥ भर्तुर्भाग्यं तु नार्येका प्राप्नोति पुरुषर्षभ। अतश्चैवाहमादिष्टा वने वस्तव्यमित्यपि॥
en: Oh dear husband, father, mother, son, brother, daughter-in-law, all of them abide by the consequences of their own actions, it is the wife alone, Oh best of men, that shares the fate of her husband; it is therefore that ever along with you I have been ordered to live in the forest.

sa: ते भित्वा रक्षसां वेगाद् वक्षांसि रुधिरप्लुताः॥ विनिष्पेतुस्तदा भूमौ वल्मीकादिव पन्नगाः।
en: And those Rākşasas, their breasts pierced with vehemence, and themselves bathed in blood, fell down to the carth, like snakes dropping down from an ant hill.

sa: मनसा तं वहन् भारं तमेवार्थं विचिन्तयन्। आत्मारामः प्रसन्नात्मा मिथिलामाससाद ह॥
en: Bearing that caution in his mind and continually thinking of it, Shuka of cheerful soul and taking delight in internal survey only, reached Mithila at last.

sa: दुर्मना व्यथिता दीना निरानन्दा तपस्विनी। पीडिता भर्तुशोकेन रुमा त्यक्ष्यति जीवितम्॥
en: Rumā, aggrieved, heart-wrung, distressed and bereft of happiness and assuming the garb of a female ascetic, because of grief for her husband, shall resign her existence.

sa: यदधीतं च पित्रा मे सम्यक् तावच्छृणुष्व यो देवैः सेन्द्रैःसर्षिमरुद्गणैः॥ पूजितः प्रवरो वंशो भार्गवो भृगुनन्दन। इमं वंशमहं पूर्वं भार्गवं ते महामुने॥
en: Which was also studied by my father, has been acquired by me. Hear with all attention, O descendant of the Bhrigu race, the history of your race, respected by Indra and all the celestials, all the Rishis and the Marutas. In this great race the great and blessed Rishi Bhrigu was born.

sa: धनुषां कूजमानानां शस्त्रौघानां च दीप्यताम्। कवचानां प्रभाभिश्च न प्राज्ञायत किञ्चन॥
en: On account of twanging bows and flashing swords and the glittering armour of the worriors everything was so confused there that nothing could be distinctly seen.

sa: शेषा हता महावीर्या राक्षसा रणमूर्धनी। घोरा दुर्विषहाः सर्वे लक्ष्मणस्याग्रजेन ते॥
en: The rest of the Rākşasas, gifted with great prowess, terrible, and difficult of being withstood, were all slain in battle by the elder brother of Laksmana.

sa: तत्र त्वां निहतं माता मया शरशताचितम्। जाह्नवी पश्यतां भीष्म गृध्रकङ्कबलाशनम्॥
en: There will your mother Jahnavi see yourself slain by my hundred arrows, O Bhishma, and be made the food of vultures and other birds of prey.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच संग्रामे न्यहनं शत्रूशरौधैर्विमलैरहम्। अग्रता लक्षये यान्तं पुरुषं पावकप्रभम्॥
en: Arjuna said When slaying my foes in battle with myriads of resplendent darts, I saw a male being of the effulgence of fire proceeding before me.

sa: नायं नृत्येद् यथा देव तथा त्वं कर्तुमर्हसि। तं प्रनृत्तं समासाद्य हर्षाविष्टेन चेतसा। सुराणां हितकामार्थमृषि देवोऽभ्यभाषत॥
en: (They said), “O deity, you should do that by which the Rishi may not dance." Coming to the dancing Rishi who was senseless in joy, the deity thus spoke to him in order to do good to the celestials.

sa: उभे मूत्रपुरीषे तु नाप्से कुर्यात् कदाचन॥ अन्नं बुभुक्षमाणस्तु त्रिर्मुखेन स्पृशेदपः।
en: One should never answer a call of nature on a piece of water. One should first wash his mouth, thrice with water before eating any food.

sa: आहारस्त्वपि सर्वस्य त्रिविधो भवति प्रियः। यज्ञस्तपस्तथा दानं तेषां भेदमिमं शृणु।॥
en: Food which is dear to all is also of three kinds. Sacrifice, penance, and gifts are also of three kinds. Hear from Me their distinction, one

sa: हतशिष्टाश्व राजानः सर्वं च कुरुजांगलाः। तान् पश्य नरशार्दूल समुन्मीलय लोचने॥
en: The remnant of unslain warriors, and all the denizens of Kurujangala, are also here, Opening the eyes, O chief of Kuru's race, do you see them.

sa: दारकेष्वप्रमत्ता च भवेथाश्च हिता ममा अतोऽन्यन्न प्रपश्यामि संदेष्टव्यं हि किंचन॥
en: You will certainly bring up the children carefully. It would be doing the greatest good to me. I do not find anything more to tell you.

sa: नवमासधृतं गर्भे भास्करस्य गभस्तिभिः। पीत्वा रसं समुद्राणां द्यौः प्रसूते रसायनम्॥
en: The sky, drinking the liquid contents of the ocean through the rays of the Sun, and being enceinite for nine months, is giving birth to showers.

sa: निर्वेदं परमं गत्वा विनिन्द्य परवश्यताम्। दीर्घ दध्यौ शान्तनवो योद्धकामोऽर्जुनं रणे॥
en: The son of Shantanu was greatly depressed; and he censored the life of dependency and reflected for a long time, desirous of encountering Arjuna in battle.

sa: ततो हि हरिशार्दूल पुनरागमनाय तु। प्राणानामपि संदेहो मम स्यान्नात्र संशयः॥
en: But even if you go (passing today here), I have, O tiger-like monkey, doubts as to your return; and, accordingly, doubt, certainly, as to my life.

sa: अथ नष्टे सहस्राक्षे उद्विग्नमभवज्जगत्। भूमिश्च ध्वस्तसंकाशा निःस्नेहा शुष्ककानना॥ निःस्रोतसस्ते सर्वे तु हृदाश्च सरितस्तथा। संक्षोभश्चैव सत्त्वानामनावृष्टिकृतोऽभवत्॥
en: And again in consequence of Indra's separation, the whole world was agitated, the forests grew dried and the earth was devoid of water. On account of the rivers being dried up and want of rain all creatures grew impatient.

sa: तद्धि पूर्वं नरश्रेष्ठ दत्तं सदसि दैवतैः। अप्रमेयबलं घोरं मखे परमभास्वरम्॥
en: And formerly this bow of immeasurable energy, and dreadful, and exceedingly effulgent at the sacrifice, had been conferred in court by the celestials (on king Devarata.)8

sa: नकुल उवाच राजन् पञ्चालराजस्य सुतेयमसितेक्षणा। श्रान्ता निपतिता भूमौ तामवेक्षस्व भारत॥
en: Nakula said: O king, O descendant of Bharata, behold, the daughter of the Panchala king, this blackeyed lady has fallen on the ground out of fatigue.

sa: कः पुमांस्तु कुले जातः स्त्रियं परगृहोषिताम्। तेजस्वी पुनरादद्यात्सुहृल्लोभेन चेतसा ॥
en: What powerful man, born in a high family, take back his wife considering her as friend out of lust, who has lived long in another's house?

sa: पूर्व सौहृदबद्धोऽस्मि वृत्रस्येह महात्मनः। तेन युष्मत्प्रियार्थं हि नाहं हन्मि महासुरम्॥
en: From before I am bound with the high-souled Vrtra by the ties of friendship. For this, even for your satisfaction, I shall not (myself) slay him.

sa: तिष्ठध्वं स्थनो यूयं संग्राममभिकाक्षिणः। युध्यामि संहतानेतान् यशो मानं च वर्धयन्॥
en: Stay, O you car-warriors that long to join in the fray! Single-handed, will I fight with the assembled Pandavas, for enhancing my glory and my fame

sa: समागच्छ यथान्यायं राज्ञा दुर्योधनेन वै। स्वर्गोऽयं नेह वैराणि भवन्ति मनुजाधिप॥ नारदेनैवमुक्तस्तु कुरुराजो युधिष्ठिरः। भ्रातन् पप्रच्छ मेधावी वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह॥ यदि दुर्योधनस्यैते वीरलोकाः सनातनाः। अधर्मज्ञस्य पापस्य पृथिवीसुहृदां दुहः॥ यत्कृते पृथिवी नष्टा सहया सनरद्विपा। वयं च मन्युना दग्धा वैरं प्रतिचिकीर्षवः॥ ये ते वीरा महात्मानो भ्रातरो मे महाव्रताः। सत्यप्रतिज्ञा लोकस्य शूरा वै सत्यवादिनः॥ तेषामिदानीं के लोका दुष्टमिच्छामि तानहम्। कर्णं चैव महात्मानं कौन्तेयं सत्यसंगरम्॥ धृष्टद्युम्नं सात्यकि
en: Do you meet Duryodhana now politely. This is Heaven, O king! There can be no enmities here! Through thus addressed by Narada, the Kuru king Yudhishthira, gifted with great intelligence, enquired about his brothers and said, If these eternal regions reserved for heroes be Duryodhana's that unrighteous and sinful wretch, that man who was the destroyer of friends and of the whole world, that man for whose sake the entire Earth was devastated with all her horses and elephants and human beings, that man for whose sake we were burnt with anger in thinking of how best we inight remedy our wrongs, I wish him to see what regions have been attained by those great heroes, my brothers of high vows, steady achievers of promises, truthful in speech, and distinguished for courage. The great Karna, the so

sa: प्रियं त्वत्कृतमिच्छामि मम गर्भविपर्यये। मरुतां सप्त सप्तानां स्थानपाला भवन्तु ते॥
en: And since calamity has befallen the embryo, I wish to do you a good turn. Let the seven parts become the guardians of the seven Maruts.

sa: कर्मणः पृथिवीपाल मम येन दुरात्मना। विघ्नः कृतो महाराज गुर्वर्थं चरतोऽनघ॥
en: O king of the world, my business was obstructed on one occasion by that wretch when I was going (to get a present for my preceptor.)

sa: संजय उवाच ततोऽर्जुनस्य भवनं प्रविश्याप्रतिमं विभुः। स्पृष्ट्वाम्भः पुण्डरीकाक्षः स्थण्डिले शुभलक्षणे॥
en: Sanjaya said Then that Lord of eyes like lotus-petals, having entered into the matchless mansion of Arjuna, touched water and on the smooth and auspicious floor.

sa: तान् विक्रमेण जित्वेमामखिलां भुक्ष्व मेदिनीम्। अतो नान्यं प्रपश्यामि कार्योपायं जनाधिप॥
en: O king, after defeating them by your prowess, rule over the wide world. I do not see any other means of becoming successful in our object.

sa: कामरूपधरा सा तु कृत्वा रूपाण्यनेकशः। अन्तर्धानं गता यक्षी मोहयन्ती स्वमायया॥
en: Thereupon that one capable of assuming forms at will, began to assume various shapes; and to vanish from sight, bewildering her antagonists with her illusory displays.

sa: सौमित्रे भुक्ष्व भोगांस्त्वमिष्टान् राज्यफलानि च। जीवितं चापि राज्यं च त्वदर्थमभिकामये॥
en: Do you, O Sumitrā's son, enjoy every desirable thing and the privileges pertaining to royalty. My life and this kingdom I covet for your sake alone.

sa: यथोक्तं त्वं गृहाणेदमक्षाणां हृदयं परम्। निक्षेपो मेऽश्वहृदयं त्वयि तिष्ठतु बाहुका एवमुक्त्वा ददौ विद्यामृतुपर्णो नलाय वै॥
en: "As you have asked, do you take from me my great skill at dice. O Bahuka, let my knowledge of horses remain with you in trust. Thus saying, king Rituparna gave Nala his knowledge of the play at dice.

sa: गङ्गाह्रदश्च ततैव कूपश्च भरतर्षभ। तिस्रः कोट्यस्तु तीर्थानां तस्मिन् कूपे महीपते॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, O ruler of earth, there is Gangahrada and another well (Tirtha); in that well thirty millions of Tirthas are present.

sa: कर्माणि यानि दिव्यानि महादेवस्य धीमतः॥ तानि ते कीर्तयिष्यामि यथाप्रज्ञं यथाश्रुतम्।
en: I shall now relate to you, according to my knowledge and as I have heard them related, all the divine deeds of the supremely wise Mahadeva.
